    "utility-ecoli-observations": ("table", "b6cf7d334c6b8bb1a174374c30e8ea3081dd1f05be2418040272c581a49264a8"),
    "utility-ecoli-stations": ("vector", "533e91201e09aa1103289722f0077edb496f4ed319deb6a4b58771fb7073a907"),
}
EXPECTED_COUNTS = {"ARJWS": {"stations": 5, "records": 142},
                   "PRWD": {"stations": 31, "records": 588}}
MAX_DOMAIN_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024


def _collection(workspace, manifest):
    """Reuse one complete current or retained predecessor presentation edition."""
    requested = None
    if manifest is not None:
        manifest = Path(manifest).resolve(strict=True)
        requested = file_digest(manifest)
        if requested not in SOURCE_EDITIONS:
            raise ValueError("Choose a complete retained utility E. coli source-manifest.json")
    candidates = [row for row in workspace._list("sources")
                  if row.get("original_manifest", {}).get("sha256") in SOURCE_EDITIONS
                  and (requested is None or row["original_manifest"]["sha256"] == requested)]
    if candidates:
        collection = sorted(candidates, key=lambda row: (
            row["original_manifest"]["sha256"] != MANIFEST_SHA256, row["id"]))[0]
    elif manifest is not None:
        collection = workspace.import_sources(manifest)
    else:
        raise ValueError("Import the original utility microbial source or select its complete manifest")
    edition = collection["original_manifest"]["sha256"]
    if edition not in SOURCE_EDITIONS:
        raise ValueError("Choose a complete retained microbial presentation edition")
    expected_entries = {**EXPECTED, "utility-ecoli-offline-explorer": (
        "document", SOURCE_EDITIONS[edition])}
    entries = {entry["id"]: entry for entry in collection["entries"]}
    for source_id, (kind, expected) in expected_entries.items():
        entry = entries.get(source_id)
        if entry is None or entry["kind"] != kind or entry["body"]["sha256"] != expected:
            raise ValueError("The retained microbial source differs: " + source_id)
        workspace.source_file(collection["id"], source_id)
    return collection, entries


def _reference(collection, entry, **fields):
    return {"collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": entry["id"],
            "source_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"], **fields}


def _domain(workspace, reference):
    """Read an exact original 217-HUC source; display outlines are never selected."""
    if not isinstance(reference, dict):
        raise ValueError("Select the original domain collection and source IDs")
    collection_id = identifier(reference.get("collection_id"))
    path, entry = workspace.source_file(collection_id, reference.get("source_id"))
    if entry["kind"] != "vector":
        raise ValueError("Choose the retained original watershed polygon source")
    expected = reference.get("source_sha256")
    if expected and entry["body"]["sha256"] != expected:
        raise ValueError("The selected domain source body changed")
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if raw[:2] == b"\x1f\x8b":
        with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as stream:
            decoded = stream.read(MAX_DOMAIN_BYTES + 1)
    else:
        decoded = raw
    if len(decoded) > MAX_DOMAIN_BYTES or hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest() != DOMAIN_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Choose the original decoded 217-HUC model domain")
    body = json.loads(decoded.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    features = body.get("features", [])
    if len(features) != 217:
        raise ValueError("Retain all 217 original HUC12 polygons")
    fields = [name for name in features[0].get("attributes", {}) if name.lower() == "huc12"]
    if len(fields) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The original domain needs its unique HUC12 field")
    field = fields[0]
    ids = [feature.get("attributes", {}).get(field) for feature in features]
    if len(set(ids)) != 217 or any(not isinstance(value, str) or
                                  len(value) != 12 or not value.isdigit() for value in ids):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original twelve-character HUC12 identities")
    return {"collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
            "source_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"], "id_field": field}


def _choose_domain(workspace, requested, mode):
    if mode not in ("auto", "none", "required"):
        raise ValueError("Choose auto, none or required original-domain receiving")
    if requested is not None:
        if mode == "none":
            raise ValueError("Choose the supplied original domain or the point-only edition")
        return _domain(workspace, requested), []
    if mode == "none":
        return None, []
    candidates = []
    for collection in sorted(workspace._list("sources"), key=lambda row: row["id"]):
        for entry in collection["entries"]:
            body = entry["body"]
            label = " ".join(str(entry.get(key, "")) for key in ("id", "title", "path"))
            label += " " + str(body.get("filename", ""))
            if entry["kind"] == "vector" and (body["sha256"] == DOMAIN_SHA256
                    or "model-domain" in label.lower() or "model domain" in label.lower()):
                candidates.append(_reference(collection, entry))
    notes = []
    for reference in candidates:
        try:
            return _domain(workspace, reference), notes
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as error:
            notes.append({"source": reference, "message": str(error)})
    if mode == "required":
        raise ValueError("Import or explicitly select the original 217-HUC domain in this Workspace")
    return None, notes


def _coordinate_sources(workspace, collection, entry, points):
    """Retain native coordinate groups from original station CSV strings and datums."""
    records = [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]
    selected = [row for row in records
                if row.get("source_path") == "raw/stations-original.csv"]
    if len(selected) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Retain the original station CSV alongside the display points")
    original_csv = relative_file(workspace.root, selected[0]["object"])
    raw = original_csv.read_bytes()
    if (len(raw) != selected[0]["bytes"]
            or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != selected[0]["sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("The original station coordinate CSV changed")
    table = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"), newline=""))
    originals = {}
    for number, row in enumerate(table, 2):
        station = row.get("MonitoringLocationIdentifier")
        if None in row or not station or station in originals:
            raise ValueError("Original station coordinate rows need distinct native identifiers")
        originals[station] = (number, row)
    definitions = {"WGS84": ("wgs84", "EPSG:4326", 34),
                   "NAD83": ("nad83", "EPSG:4269", 2)}
    groups = {datum: [] for datum in definitions}
    source_rows = []
    for feature in points["features"]:
        properties = feature["properties"]
        station = properties["MonitoringLocationIdentifier"]
        if station not in originals:
            raise ValueError("Original station CSV does not contain " + station)
        number, row = originals[station]
        if any(properties.get(name) != value for name, value in row.items()):
            raise ValueError("The selected station attributes differ from the original CSV: " + station)
        datum = row.get("HorizontalCoordinateReferenceSystemDatumName")
        if datum not in definitions:
            raise ValueError("Retain an explicit supported original coordinate datum")
        x = finite(row["LongitudeMeasure"], "Original station longitude")
        y = finite(row["LatitudeMeasure"], "Original station latitude")
        if not -180 <= x <= 180 or not -90 <= y <= 90:
            raise ValueError("Original geographic coordinates are outside their native bounds")
        groups[datum].append({"type": "Feature", "id": station,
            "geometry": {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [x, y]},
            "properties": {**properties, "original_station_source_row": number,
                "native_coordinate_basis": "Original WQP CSV coordinate strings and declared datum"}})
        source_rows.append({"station_id": station, "source_row": number,
            "datum": datum, "source_crs": definitions[datum][1],
            "longitude_text": row["LongitudeMeasure"], "latitude_text": row["LatitudeMeasure"]})
    if any(len(groups[datum]) != expected
           for datum, (_, _, expected) in definitions.items()):
        raise ValueError("Retain all 34 WGS84 and two NAD83 original station positions")
    identity = {"schema": "upstate.utility-microbial-coordinates/v1",
        "source_collection_id": collection["id"],
        "display_source_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
        "coordinate_source_sha256": selected[0]["sha256"],
        "coordinate_fields": ["LongitudeMeasure", "LatitudeMeasure",
                              "HorizontalCoordinateReferenceSystemDatumName"],
        "selected_stations": source_rows}
    key = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / "utility-microbial-coordinate-sources" / key
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".coordinates.lock", blocking=False):
        companions, seen = [], set()
        for body in records:
            name = body.get("view_path", body["filename"])
            member = PurePosixPath(name)
            if (member.is_absolute() or not member.parts or ".." in member.parts
                    or member.as_posix() != name or "\\" in name or "\0" in name or name in seen):
                raise ValueError("Retain distinct portable original coordinate-source members")
            seen.add(name)
            source = relative_file(workspace.root, body["object"])
            content = source.read_bytes()
            if len(content) != body["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != body["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("An original microbial source companion changed")
            target = directory / "original" / name
            atomic_bytes(target, content, immutable=True)
            companions.append({"path": "original/" + name, "sha256": body["sha256"]})
        atomic_json(directory / "coordinate-derivation.json", identity, immutable=True)
        companions.append({"path": "coordinate-derivation.json",
                           "sha256": file_digest(directory / "coordinate-derivation.json")})
        native_entries = []
        for datum, (code, crs, expected) in definitions.items():
            filename = "stations-" + code + ".geojson"
            native = {"type": "FeatureCollection",
                "name": "Original utility-focus station coordinates — " + datum,
                "crs": {"type": "name", "properties": {"name": crs}},
                "features": groups[datum]}
            atomic_json(directory / filename, native, immutable=True)
            native_entries.append({"id": "utility-ecoli-native-" + code,
                "title": "Original utility-focus station coordinates — " + datum,
                "kind": "vector", "format": "geojson", "path": filename,
                "sha256": file_digest(directory / filename),
                "uri": entry["uri"], "vintage": entry["vintage"],
                "source_crs": crs, "station_id_field": "MonitoringLocationIdentifier",
                "native_id_field": "MonitoringLocationIdentifier",
                "station_count": expected, "coordinate_datum": datum,
                "original_source_collection_id": collection["id"],
                "original_station_csv_sha256": selected[0]["sha256"],
                "coordinate_basis": "Unchanged original coordinate values, partitioned by declared datum",
                "companions": companions})
        manifest = {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1",
            "title": "Utility-focus microbial stations — original coordinate systems",
            "captured_at": collection.get("captured_at"),
            "scope": {"coordinate_derivation": identity},
            "notes": ["The original coordinate strings are retained in feature properties.",
                      "Native Station geography performs its ordinary CRS transformation.",
                      "The independent offline display and original source bodies remain preserved."],
            "entries": native_entries}
        manifest_path = directory / "sources.json"
        atomic_json(manifest_path, manifest, immutable=True)
        retained = workspace.import_sources(manifest_path)
        references = []
        for native_entry in retained["entries"]:
            workspace.source_file(retained["id"], native_entry["id"])
            references.append(_reference(retained, native_entry, format="geojson",
                station_id_field="MonitoringLocationIdentifier",
                native_id_field="MonitoringLocationIdentifier",
                source_crs=native_entry["source_crs"]))
        return retained, references


def _selection(workspace, collection, entries, domain, title):
    path, unused = workspace.source_file(collection["id"], "utility-ecoli-stations")
    points = read_json(path)
    stations = {}
    for feature in points["features"]:
        properties = feature["properties"]
        station_id = properties["MonitoringLocationIdentifier"]
        if station_id in stations or feature["geometry"]["type"] != "Point":
            raise ValueError("Retain the 36 distinct original station points")
        utility = properties["utility_id"]
        if utility not in EXPECTED_COUNTS:
            raise ValueError("Retain the original utility-focus assignment")
        stations[station_id] = {
            "station_id": station_id, "label": properties["MonitoringLocationName"],
            "utility_id": utility, "publisher_huc8": properties["HUCEightDigitCode"],
            "utility_membership_basis": properties["source_membership_basis"],
            "original_matched_huc12": properties.get("matched_huc12"),
            "source_references": [{"collection_id": collection["id"],
                "source_id": "utility-ecoli-stations",
                "source_sha256": entries["utility-ecoli-stations"]["body"]["sha256"],
                "station_id_field": "MonitoringLocationIdentifier", "station_id": station_id}],
        }
    path, unused = workspace.source_file(collection["id"], "utility-ecoli-observations")
    with Path(path).open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as stream:
        reader = csv.DictReader(stream)
        records = list(reader)
    required = {"MonitoringLocationIdentifier", "ActivityIdentifier", "CharacteristicName",
                "ResultMeasureValue", "ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode", "ResultDetectionConditionText",
                "ActivityStartDate", "utility_id", "source_file", "source_row"}
    if not reader.fieldnames or not required <= set(reader.fieldnames):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original microbial result columns")
    seen = set()
    for row in records:
        station_id, activity = row["MonitoringLocationIdentifier"], row["ActivityIdentifier"]
        if (None in row or station_id not in stations or not activity or activity in seen
                or row["CharacteristicName"] != "Escherichia coli"
                or row["utility_id"] != stations[station_id]["utility_id"]):
            raise ValueError("An original microbial activity or station binding differs")
        seen.add(activity)
    counts = {utility: {"stations": sum(row["utility_id"] == utility for row in stations.values()),
                        "records": sum(row["utility_id"] == utility for row in records)}
              for utility in EXPECTED_COUNTS}
    if counts != EXPECTED_COUNTS or len(seen) != 730 or len(stations) != 36:
        raise ValueError("Retain the complete 730-result, 36-station utility source edition")
    coordinate_collection, coordinate_sources = _coordinate_sources(
        workspace, collection, entries["utility-ecoli-stations"], points)
    table_entry = entries["utility-ecoli-observations"]
    selection = {
        "title": title,
        "sources": coordinate_sources,
        "observation_tables": [_reference(collection, table_entry,
                    station_id_field="MonitoringLocationIdentifier",
                    record_id_field="ActivityIdentifier")],
        "observation_ids": [], "site_tables": [], "sites": list(stations.values()),
        "watersheds": [domain] if domain is not None else [],
        "aliases": {}, "choices": {},
        "microbial_context": {
            "source_manifest_sha256": collection["original_manifest"]["sha256"],
            "period": {"start": "2021-01-01", "end": "2025-12-31"},
            "quantity": "Original sampled E. coli concentration and detection/quantitation condition",
            "utility_source_counts": counts,
            "geographic_basis": "Original WQP CSV coordinates and declared WGS84/NAD83 datums",
            "coordinate_source_collection_id": coordinate_collection["id"],
            "coordinate_source_counts": {"EPSG:4326": 34, "EPSG:4269": 2},
            "watershed_basis": "Original 217-HUC polygon membership" if domain else
                               "Point and utility-source context; watershed overlay not selected",
            "original_report_source_id": "utility-ecoli-offline-explorer",
        },
    }
    return selection, counts


def prepare(workspace, *, manifest=None, title=TITLE, domain_reference=None, domain_mode="auto"):
    """Import/reuse the actual original source and retain an ordinary native selection."""
    title = str(title).strip()
    if not title:
        raise ValueError("Name the saved original observation study")
    collection, entries = _collection(workspace, manifest)
    domain, source_notes = _choose_domain(workspace, domain_reference, domain_mode)
    selection, counts = _selection(workspace, collection, entries, domain, title)
    identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"],
                "source_collection_id": collection["id"], "selection": selection}
    key = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / FOLDER / key
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".selection.lock", blocking=False):
        atomic_json(directory / "selection.json", selection, immutable=True)
        value = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "identity": identity, "title": title,
                 "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "source_collection_id": collection["id"],
                 "selection": selection, "source_counts": counts,
                 "domain": domain, "source_notes": source_notes,
                 "action": "station.geography.build", "payload": {"selection": selection},
                 "files": {"selection": describe_file(directory, directory / "selection.json")}}
        # Availability notes describe this preparation; immutable selection carries source identity.
        atomic_json(directory / "preparation.json", value)
        return {**value, "directory": str(directory),
                "files": {**value["files"],
                          "preparation": describe_file(directory, directory / "preparation.json")}}


def build(workspace, *, manifest=None, title=TITLE, domain_reference=None, domain_mode="auto"):
    """Use the maintained station engine, retaining its original report, map and archive."""
    from . import station_geography
    prepared = prepare(workspace, manifest=manifest, title=title,
                       domain_reference=domain_reference, domain_mode=domain_mode)
    directory = Path(prepared["directory"])
    with held(directory / ".build.lock", blocking=False):
        saved = station_geography.build(workspace, prepared["selection"])
        received = station_geography.inspect(workspace, saved["id"], verify=True, include_result=True)
        summary = received["summary"]
        expected = {"station_count": 36, "located_count": 36, "unresolved_count": 0,
                    "observation_count": 730, "unassigned_observation_count": 0}
        if any(summary.get(name) != count for name, count in expected.items()):
            raise ValueError("The native station study must retain all 36 points and 730 original activity links")
        report_path, report_entry = workspace.source_file(
            prepared["source_collection_id"], "utility-ecoli-offline-explorer")
        receipt = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "id": prepared["id"], "state": "complete",
            "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "title": prepared["title"],
            "source_collection_id": prepared["source_collection_id"],
            "station_geography_id": received["id"],
            "station_geography_build_id": received["build_id"],
            "spatial_source_collection_id": received["source_collection_id"],
            "selection": prepared["selection"], "source_counts": prepared["source_counts"],
            "summary": summary, "domain": prepared["domain"],
            "original_report": {"source_id": report_entry["id"],
                                "source_sha256": report_entry["body"]["sha256"],
                                "local_path": str(report_path)},
            "station_geography_files": received["files"],
        }
        atomic_json(directory / "receiving.json", receipt)
        return {**receipt, "directory": str(directory),
                "receiving_file": describe_file(workspace.root, directory / "receiving.json")}


def inspect(workspace, operation_id):
    from . import station_geography
    directory = workspace.root / FOLDER / identifier(operation_id)
    preparation = read_json(directory / "preparation.json")
    if (preparation.get("schema") != SCHEMA or preparation.get("id") != operation_id
            or digest(preparation["identity"]) != operation_id
            or preparation.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"]):
        raise ValueError("Choose this Workspace's original microbial study preparation")
    selection_path = verify_file(directory, preparation["files"]["selection"])
    if (preparation["selection"] != preparation["identity"]["selection"]
            or read_json(selection_path) != preparation["selection"]):
        raise ValueError("The retained microbial selection differs from its original identity")
    receipt = read_json(directory / "receiving.json")
    if (receipt.get("id") != operation_id or receipt.get("state") != "complete"
            or receipt["selection"] != preparation["selection"]):
        raise ValueError("Choose a completed original microbial study receiving")
    native = station_geography.inspect(workspace, receipt["station_geography_id"], verify=True)
    if native["selection"] != receipt["selection"]:
        raise ValueError("The saved native geography selection differs")
    report, unused = workspace.source_file(receipt["source_collection_id"],
                                          receipt["original_report"]["source_id"])
    return {**receipt, "original_report": {**receipt["original_report"], "local_path": str(report)},
            "station_geography_files": native["files"], "directory": str(directory),
            "receiving_file": describe_file(workspace.root, directory / "receiving.json")}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=SOURCE_DIRECTORY / "source-manifest.json")
    parser.add_argument("--retained-only", action="store_true",
                        help="Use the already imported original source without a local manifest")
    parser.add_argument("--title", default=TITLE)
    parser.add_argument("--domain-mode", choices=("auto", "none", "required"), default="auto")
    parser.add_argument("--domain-collection")
    parser.add_argument("--domain-source")
    parser.add_argument("action", choices=("prepare", "build", "inspect"))
    parser.add_argument("--operation-id", help="Saved microbial study identity for inspect")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    from .workspace import Workspace
    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace.resolve(strict=True))
    if bool(args.domain_collection) != bool(args.domain_source):
        parser.error("Supply the original domain collection and source together")
    if args.action == "inspect":
        if not args.operation_id:
            parser.error("Inspect requires the retained operation identity")
        result = inspect(workspace, args.operation_id)
    else:
        reference = ({"collection_id": args.domain_collection, "source_id": args.domain_source}
                     if args.domain_collection else None)
        result = (prepare if args.action == "prepare" else build)(
            workspace, manifest=None if args.retained_only else args.manifest,
            title=args.title, domain_reference=reference, domain_mode=args.domain_mode)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

files.model/utility_monitoring.py:
"""Turn an original saved utility footprint into a retained monitoring network.

The maintained receiving-water and Monitoring engines own geometry, graph,
candidate weights and design. This adapter binds the existing source report,
whole original HUC polygons and original WQP station coordinates to that course.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import tempfile

from .common import (atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest,
                     held, identifier, now, read_json, relative_file, verify_file)
from . import receiving_waters as water, receiving_water_monitoring as monitoring
from . import utility_microbial_study as microbial
from .monitoring_sources import read_source
from . import monitoring_sources

SCHEMA = "upstate.utility-monitoring/v1"
VERSION = "utility-source-monitoring/1"
FOLDER = "utility-monitoring"
FOOTPRINT_ID = "utility-whole-huc-monitoring-footprint"
STATIONS_ID = "utility-original-microbial-stations"
METHOD = (
    "Selected original whole HUC12 polygons form the utility planning footprint. "
    "Each candidate's weight is its EPSG:5070 overlap hectares with that union. "
    "The complete original model-domain HUC/ToHUC graph remains in the network. "
    "Original sampled station coordinates are transformed from their declared datum; "
    "publisher utility membership and native polygon assignment remain separate."
)


def _copy_file(source, directory, member, descriptor):
    """Retain one complete original in bounded memory and fsync before publishing."""
    member = PurePosixPath(member)
    if member.is_absolute() or ".." in member.parts or "\\" in str(member):
        raise ValueError("Retain a portable original source path")
    target = directory / member
    expected = {"path": str(member), "bytes": descriptor["bytes"], "sha256": descriptor["sha256"]}
    if target.exists():
        verify_file(directory, expected)
        return expected
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".utility-source-", dir=target.parent)
    path = Path(temporary)
    try:
        size, checksum = 0, hashlib.sha256()
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output, Path(source).open("rb") as original:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: original.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                output.write(chunk); size += len(chunk); checksum.update(chunk)
            output.flush(); os.fsync(output.fileno())
        if size != expected["bytes"] or checksum.hexdigest() != expected["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("An original utility monitoring source changed")
        os.replace(path, target)
        if os.name != "nt":
            parent = os.open(target.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
            try: os.fsync(parent)
            finally: os.close(parent)
    finally:
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return expected


def _source_files(workspace, choice, directory, label):
    """Copy full retained originals with their native source manifest and sidecars."""
    collection = workspace._get("sources", choice["source_collection_id"])
    entry = next(row for row in collection["entries"] if row["id"] == choice["source_id"])
    prefix = "original/" + label + "/"
    records, seen = [], set()
    for body in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        name = body.get("view_path", body["filename"])
        if name in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(name)
        original = relative_file(workspace.root, body["object"])
        records.append(_copy_file(original, directory, prefix + name, body))
    for name, value in (("source-edition.json", collection), ("source-choice.json", choice)):
        path = directory / (prefix + name)
        atomic_json(path, value, immutable=True)
        records.append(describe_file(directory, path))
    original_manifest = collection["original_manifest"]
    records.append(_copy_file(relative_file(workspace.root, original_manifest["object"]),
                              directory, prefix + "original-manifest.json", original_manifest))
    return records


def export_selection(workspace, export_id):
    """Verify the existing saved utility report and its original profile selection."""
    key = identifier(export_id)
    directory = workspace.root / "watershed-context-exports" / key
    record = read_json(directory / "export.json")
    if (record.get("schema") != "upstate.watershed-context-export/v1"
            or record.get("id") != key or record.get("state") != "complete"):
        raise ValueError("Choose a completed original utility watershed export")
    selection_path = verify_file(directory, record["files"]["selected-watersheds.json"])
    selection = read_json(selection_path)
    utility = selection.get("utility_selection")
    if (selection.get("schema") != "upstate.selected-watersheds/v1"
            or selection.get("export_id") != key
            or not isinstance(utility, dict) or not utility.get("available")
            or utility != record.get("utility_selection")
            or utility.get("key") != record.get("utility_selection_sha256")
            or digest({k: v for k, v in utility.items() if k != "key"}) != utility["key"]):
        raise ValueError("The saved report must retain its complete original utility choice")
    hucs = utility["huc12s"]
    if (hucs != sorted(set(hucs)) or not hucs
            or selection.get("selected_huc12s") != hucs or record.get("huc12s") != hucs):
        raise ValueError("The saved utility HUC membership differs")
    report_id = record.get("report_id")
    if not isinstance(report_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"watershed-[0-9a-f]{20}", report_id):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original regional report identity")
    parent_root = workspace.root / "watershed-context" / report_id
    parent = read_json(parent_root / "operator-report.json")
    if parent.get("id") != report_id or parent.get("schema") != "upstate.operator-watershed-context/v1":
        raise ValueError("The original regional report edition changed")
    parent_path = verify_file(parent_root, parent["files"]["watershed-context.json"])
    parent_report = read_json(parent_path)
    if (file_digest(parent_path) != record["report_sha256"]
            or parent_report.get("id") != report_id
            or digest(parent_report) != utility["report_canonical_sha256"]
            or selection.get("context_canonical_sha256") != digest(parent_report)):
        raise ValueError("The utility selection differs from its complete original regional report")
    profile = verify_file(directory, record["files"]["original-utility-profile.json"])
    if file_digest(profile) != utility["profile_source"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The original utility profile changed")
    # Existing export ZIP retains the original observations, their methods/units,
    # source comments, geographic interpretation and all relative source links.
    packet = verify_file(directory, record["files"]["utility-watershed-packet.zip"])
    return directory, record, selection, utility, packet


def _domain(workspace, requested):
    reference, notes = microbial._choose_domain(workspace, requested, "required")
    choice = {"source_collection_id": reference["collection_id"],
              "source_id": reference["source_id"]}
    rows, source = water._source(workspace, choice, "EPSG:5070")
    fields = list(rows[0]["properties"])
    downstream = [name for name in fields if name.casefold() == "tohuc"]
    if len(downstream) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Select the original unambiguous ToHUC field")
    choice.update(id_field=reference["id_field"], downstream_field=downstream[0])
    graph = water.huc_graph(rows, id_field=choice["id_field"],
                            downstream_field=choice["downstream_field"])
    return choice, reference, rows, source, graph, notes


def _stations(workspace, utility, domain_reference, include):
    if not include:
        return None
    manifest = microbial.SOURCE_DIRECTORY / "source-manifest.json"
    prepared = microbial.prepare(
        workspace, manifest=manifest if manifest.is_file() else None,
        domain_reference=domain_reference, domain_mode="required")
    features, sources = [], []
    for reference in prepared["selection"]["sources"]:
        native, binding = read_source(workspace, reference["source_id"],
                                      collection_id=reference["collection_id"])
        # The existing native vector reader honors the WGS84/NAD83 source datum.
        selected = [feature for feature in native["features"]
                    if feature["properties"].get("utility_id") == utility["utility_id"]]
        features.extend(selected)
        sources.append({"source_collection_id": reference["collection_id"],
                        "source_id": reference["source_id"], "binding": binding,
                        "selected_station_ids": [
                            row["properties"]["MonitoringLocationIdentifier"] for row in selected]})
    ids = [row["properties"]["MonitoringLocationIdentifier"] for row in features]
    expected = microbial.EXPECTED_COUNTS[utility["utility_id"]]["stations"]
    if len(ids) != expected or len(set(ids)) != expected:
        raise ValueError("Retain every original station in the utility's published source group")
    return {"features": features, "sources": sources, "preparation_id": prepared["id"],
            "source_collection_id": prepared["source_collection_id"],
            "source_counts": prepared["source_counts"][utility["utility_id"]]}


def prepare(workspace, value, *, progress=None):
    """Prepare one source-only network; its native design remains an explicit choice."""
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - {"export_id", "domain", "include_microbial"}:
        raise ValueError("Select a saved utility export, original domain and station option")
    include = value.get("include_microbial", True)
    if type(include) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("Choose whether to include the original microbial station locations")
    with held(workspace.root / ".utility-monitoring.lock", blocking=False):
        return _prepare(workspace, value, include, progress)


def _prepare(workspace, value, include, progress):
    from shapely.geometry import mapping

    source_root, export, selected, utility, packet = export_selection(workspace, value.get("export_id"))
    catchments, domain, rows, original, graph, notes = _domain(workspace, value.get("domain"))
    chosen = set(utility["huc12s"])
    by_huc = {str(row["properties"][catchments["id_field"]]): row for row in rows}
    if len(by_huc) != 217 or chosen - by_huc.keys():
        raise ValueError("The original utility footprint must belong to the retained 217-HUC domain")
    stations = _stations(workspace, utility, domain, include)
    identity = {"version": VERSION, "implementation_sha256": file_digest(__file__),
                "pipeline_sources": {module.__name__: file_digest(module.__file__)
                                     for module in (water, monitoring, microbial, monitoring_sources)},
                "selected_geometry_sha256": {huc: hashlib.sha256(by_huc[huc]["geometry"].wkb).hexdigest()
                                            for huc in sorted(chosen)},
                "transformed_station_sha256": digest(stations["features"]) if stations else None,
                "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"], "export_id": export["id"],
                "utility_key": utility["key"],
                "selection_file": export["files"]["selected-watersheds.json"],
                "source_packet": export["files"]["utility-watershed-packet.zip"],
                "domain": domain, "catchments": catchments, "original_domain": original,
                "include_microbial": include,
                "station_sources": stations["sources"] if stations else [],
                "station_preparation_id": stations["preparation_id"] if stations else None}
    key = digest(identity)
    directory = workspace.root / FOLDER / key
    with held(directory / ".operation.lock", blocking=False):
        if (directory / "operation.json").exists():
            return {**inspect(workspace, key), "reused": True}
        intent_path = directory / "intent.json"
        if intent_path.exists():
            intent = read_json(intent_path)
            if intent["identity"] != identity or intent["id"] != key:
                raise ValueError("The retained utility monitoring intent changed")
        else:
            intent = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "identity": identity, "created_at": now()}
            atomic_json(intent_path, intent, immutable=True)
        if progress:
            progress({"phase": "utility_monitoring_sources", "utility_id": utility["utility_id"]})
        companions = _source_files(workspace, catchments, directory, "domain")
        companions.append(_copy_file(
            packet, directory, "original/utility-watershed-packet.zip",
            export["files"]["utility-watershed-packet.zip"]))
        companions.append(_copy_file(
            verify_file(source_root, export["files"]["selected-watersheds.json"]),
            directory, "original/selected-watersheds.json",
            export["files"]["selected-watersheds.json"]))
        companions.append(_copy_file(
            verify_file(source_root, export["files"]["original-utility-profile.json"]),
            directory, "original/original-utility-profile.json",
            export["files"]["original-utility-profile.json"]))
        atomic_json(directory / "original/export.json", export, immutable=True)
        companions.append(describe_file(directory, directory / "original/export.json"))
        footprint = {"type": "FeatureCollection",
                     "crs": {"type": "name", "properties": {"name": "EPSG:5070"}}, "features": [
            {"type": "Feature", "id": by_huc[huc]["id"],
             "properties": {**by_huc[huc]["properties"], "utility_id": utility["utility_id"],
                            "original_native_id": by_huc[huc]["id"]},
             "geometry": mapping(by_huc[huc]["geometry"])}
            for huc in sorted(chosen)]}
        atomic_json(directory / "utility-footprint.geojson", footprint, immutable=True)
        reachable = set(water.upstream_hucs(graph, utility["anchor_huc12s"]))
        method = {"schema": SCHEMA, "version": VERSION, "description": METHOD,
                  "utility": copy.deepcopy(utility), "selected_huc12s": sorted(chosen),
                  "geographic_basis": "Whole original selected HUC12 polygons",
                  "target_quantity": "EPSG:5070 vector overlap hectares",
                  "target_units": "ha", "costs_and_calendar": "Explicit choices in the original Monitoring design",
                  "station_basis": "Original WQP datum-aware coordinates and utility-source membership" if stations else "No station source selected",
                  "station_source_counts": stations["source_counts"] if stations else None,
                  "graph_upstream_huc12s": sorted(reachable),
                  "selected_not_reachable_in_retained_graph": sorted(chosen - reachable),
                  "reachable_outside_selected_utility": sorted(reachable - chosen),
                  "known_external_upstream_huc12s": utility.get("known_external_upstream_huc12s", []),
                  "interpretation": [
                      utility["interpretation"],
                      "The target weight is planning area, not microbial concentration, annual pollutant mass, removal or detection probability.",
                      "Historical sampled stations are candidate source locations, not assumed operational coverage or verified outlets.",
                      "The source report uses its original 303-record topology; Monitoring retains the supplied 217-polygon graph and its explicit external edges.",
                      "Review upstream coverage if the retained graph and saved utility membership differ; local coverage keeps the exact selected planning units."]}
        atomic_json(directory / "method.json", method, immutable=True)
        companions.append(describe_file(directory, directory / "method.json"))
        entries = [{"id": FOOTPRINT_ID, "title": utility["title"] + " — whole-HUC planning footprint",
                    "kind": "vector", "role": "UTILITY_MONITORING_FOOTPRINT",
                    "path": "utility-footprint.geojson", "sha256": file_digest(directory / "utility-footprint.geojson"),
                    "uri": original["uri"], "vintage": original["vintage"],
                    "source_crs": "EPSG:5070", "units": "original whole HUC12 polygons",
                    "scope": {"utility_export_id": export["id"], "utility_id": utility["utility_id"],
                              "huc12s": sorted(chosen), "method": method},
                    "companions": []}]
        if stations:
            for index, source in enumerate(stations["sources"]):
                companions.extend(_source_files(workspace, source, directory, "stations-" + str(index)))
            atomic_json(directory / "original-stations.geojson",
                        {"type": "FeatureCollection", "features": stations["features"]}, immutable=True)
            entries.append({"id": STATIONS_ID, "title": utility["title"] + " — original microbial stations",
                            "kind": "vector", "role": "MONITORING_STATIONS",
                            "path": "original-stations.geojson",
                            "sha256": file_digest(directory / "original-stations.geojson"),
                            "uri": "https://www.waterqualitydata.us/", "vintage": "2021–2025 original source query",
                            "station_id_field": "MonitoringLocationIdentifier",
                            "source_crs": "EPSG:4326", "scope": {"utility_id": utility["utility_id"],
                            "original_source_counts": stations["source_counts"],
                            "coordinate_sources": stations["sources"]}, "companions": []})
        # Every entry carries the full original scope and the same method.
        unique = {row["path"]: row for row in companions}
        for entry in entries:
            entry["companions"] = [{"path": row["path"], "sha256": row["sha256"]}
                                   for row in unique.values()]
        manifest = {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": utility["title"] + " — monitoring preparation",
                    "captured_at": intent["created_at"], "scope": identity, "notes": method["interpretation"],
                    "entries": entries}
        atomic_json(directory / "sources.json", manifest, immutable=True)
        collection = workspace.import_sources(directory / "sources.json")
        receptor_id = "utility-" + utility["utility_id"].lower()
        plan_selection = {"title": utility["title"] + " — whole-HUC monitoring footprint",
                          "analysis_crs": "EPSG:5070", "receptors": [{
                              "id": receptor_id, "title": utility["title"],
                              "family": "critical_drinking_water",
                              "source": {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": FOOTPRINT_ID},
                              "relation": {"method": "source_area", "rationale": utility["interpretation"]},
                              "classification": {"designation": "Utility whole-HUC planning footprint",
                                                 "source_profile": utility["profile_source"]},
                              "metadata": {"utility_export_id": export["id"], "method": method}}]}
        plan = water.prepare(workspace, plan_selection)
        selection = {"title": utility["title"] + " — source-area monitoring",
                     "mode": "contribution_area", "plan_id": plan["id"], "receptor_ids": [receptor_id],
                     "catchments": catchments}
        if stations:
            selection["stations"] = {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": STATIONS_ID,
                                     "id_field": "MonitoringLocationIdentifier"}
        bridge = monitoring.prepare(workspace, selection, progress=progress)
        expected_excluded = sorted(set(by_huc) - chosen)
        if sorted(bridge["method"]["recommended_excluded_ids"]) != expected_excluded:
            raise ValueError("The native monitoring candidate footprint differs from the exact selected HUCs")
        result = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "state": "complete",
                  "identity": identity, "created_at": intent["created_at"], "title": utility["title"],
                  "export_id": export["id"], "utility_id": utility["utility_id"],
                  "source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": FOOTPRINT_ID,
                  "receiving_plan_id": plan["id"], "monitoring_id": bridge["id"],
                  "network_id": bridge["network_id"], "method": method,
                  "summary": bridge["summary"], "network_summary": bridge["network_summary"],
                  "station_assignment_issues": bridge["station_assignment_issues"],
                  "recommended_excluded_ids": expected_excluded,
                  "original_domain_notes": notes,
                  "files": {name: describe_file(directory, directory / name)
                            for name in ("intent.json", "method.json", "sources.json", "utility-footprint.geojson",
                                         "original/utility-watershed-packet.zip",
                                         "original/selected-watersheds.json", "original/original-utility-profile.json",
                                         "original/export.json")}}
        if stations:
            result["files"]["original-stations.geojson"] = describe_file(directory, directory / "original-stations.geojson")
        result["record_sha256"] = digest(result)
        atomic_json(directory / "operation.json", result, immutable=True)
        return result


def inspect(workspace, operation_id, *, verify=True):
    key = identifier(operation_id)
    directory = workspace.root / FOLDER / key
    result = read_json(directory / "operation.json")
    if (result.get("schema") != SCHEMA or result.get("id") != key
            or result.get("state") != "complete" or digest(result["identity"]) != key
            or result["identity"]["workspace_id"] != workspace.project["id"]
            or digest({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "record_sha256"}) != result.get("record_sha256")):
        raise ValueError("Choose this Workspace's unchanged complete utility monitoring preparation")
    if verify:
        export_selection(workspace, result["export_id"])
        for row in result["files"].values():
            verify_file(directory, row)
        workspace.source_file(result["source_collection_id"], result["source_id"])
        plan = water.inspect_plan(workspace, result["receiving_plan_id"])
        bridge = monitoring.inspect(workspace, result["monitoring_id"])
        if (bridge["plan_id"] != plan["id"] or bridge["network_id"] != result["network_id"]
                or bridge["identity"]["selection"]["catchments"] != result["identity"]["catchments"]):
            raise ValueError("The utility preparation and retained native monitoring network differ")
    return result


def catalog(workspace):
    return [{name: row.get(name) for name in (
        "id", "title", "created_at", "export_id", "utility_id", "network_id",
        "monitoring_id", "summary", "network_summary", "station_assignment_issues",
        "recommended_excluded_ids")}
        for path in sorted((workspace.root / FOLDER).glob("*/operation.json"))
        for row in [inspect(workspace, path.parent.name, verify=False)]]


def main(argv=None):
    from .workspace import Workspace
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    make = commands.add_parser("prepare")
    make.add_argument("--export-id", required=True)
    make.add_argument("--without-microbial", action="store_true")
    show = commands.add_parser("inspect")
    show.add_argument("--operation-id", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("list")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace)
    result = (prepare(workspace, {"export_id": args.export_id,
                                 "include_microbial": not args.without_microbial})
              if args.command == "prepare" else
              inspect(workspace, args.operation_id) if args.command == "inspect" else catalog(workspace))
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Persistent source editions, parameter profiles, scenarios and native runs."""
from __future__ import annotations
import csv
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
import uuid
from .common import (SCHEMA, INVEST_VERSION, ROLES, atomic_json, canonical,
                     describe_file, digest, file_digest, held, identifier, now,
                     read_json, relative_file, retain_file, verify_file,
                     _retained_object_matches, _sync_directory)
from .profiles import checked_parameters, inspect_table, scenario_spec
from .model_selection import (normalize_selection, selected, grid_models, run_models,
                              required_roles, validate_completed_run)
from .grid_reuse import retain_grid_definition, reuse_grid_inputs
from .record_catalog import ProjectedFileCache, delivery_summary
from .operator_catalog import OperatorCatalogue
from .verified_files import verified_operation

class Workspace:
    def __init__(self, root, *, create=False, title="Upper Savannah scientific workspace"):
        self.root = Path(root).resolve()
        if create:
            self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with held(self.root / ".workspace.lock"):
                manifest = self.root / "workspace.json"
                if not manifest.exists():
                    atomic_json(manifest, {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                                           "title": title, "created_at": now()}, immutable=True)
        self._delivery_catalog_cache = ProjectedFileCache()
        self._operator_catalog = OperatorCatalogue(self.root)
        self.project = read_json(self.root / "workspace.json")
        if self.project.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
            raise ValueError("Select an original Upper Savannah scientific workspace")

    def _save(self, kind, payload):
        value = {key: item for key, item in dict(payload).items() if key not in ("id", "schema")}
        value["schema"] = "upstate." + kind + "/v1"
        key = digest(value)
        atomic_json(self.root / kind / (key + ".json"), value, immutable=True)
        return {**value, "id": key}

    def _get(self, kind, key):
        key = identifier(key)
        value = read_json(self.root / kind / (key + ".json"))
        if digest(value) != key:
            raise ValueError("Retained " + kind + " item changed")
        return {**value, "id": key}

    def _list(self, kind):
        folder = self.root / kind
        return [self._get(kind, p.stem) for p in sorted(folder.glob("*.json"))] if folder.exists() else []

    def overview(self):
        """Return all original records, preserving the complete model API."""
        return self._overview()

    def operator_overview(self):
        """Catalogue projection for opt-in live operator polling."""
        paths = sorted((self.root / "deliveries").glob("*/delivery-state.json"))
        self._delivery_catalog_cache.retain_paths(paths)
        rows = [self._delivery_catalog_cache.read(path, delivery_summary) for path in paths]
        return self._overview(delivery_rows=rows, catalogue=self._operator_catalog)

    def _overview(self, *, delivery_rows=None, catalogue=None):
        visited = []

        def immutable(kind):
            return catalogue.immutable(kind, visited) if catalogue else self._list(kind)

        def mutable(kind, filename):
            if catalogue:
                return catalogue.mutable(kind, filename, visited)
            return [read_json(path) for path in sorted((self.root / kind).glob("*/" + filename))]

        result = {"project": self.project, "sources": immutable("sources"),
                "profiles": immutable("profiles"), "scenarios": immutable("scenarios"),
                "grids": mutable("grids", "grid.json"),
                "runs": mutable("runs", "run.json"),
                "observations": immutable("observations"),
                "scenario_analyses": mutable("analyses", "summary.json"),
                "community_tables": immutable("community-tables"),
                "community_plans": immutable("community-plans"),
                "community_reports": immutable("community-reports"),
                "planning_inventories": immutable("planning-inventories"),
                "portfolios": immutable("portfolios"),
                "portfolio_reports": immutable("portfolio-reports"),
                "spatial_reviews": immutable("spatial-reviews"),
                "customer_reviews": immutable("reviews"),
                "customer_review_responses": immutable("review-responses"),
                "spatial_exports": mutable("spatial-exports", "export.json"),
                "observation_comparisons": immutable("observation-comparisons"),
                "comparisons": mutable("comparisons", "comparison.json"),
                "deliveries": delivery_rows if delivery_rows is not None else
                    mutable("deliveries", "delivery-state.json")}
        if catalogue:
            catalogue.finish(visited)
        return result

    def retained_item(self, kind, key):
        """Open one original record without enumerating unrelated workspace data."""
        immutable = {
            "sources": "sources", "profiles": "profiles", "scenarios": "scenarios",
            "observations": "observations", "community_tables": "community-tables",
            "community_plans": "community-plans", "community_reports": "community-reports",
            "planning_inventories": "planning-inventories", "portfolios": "portfolios",
            "portfolio_reports": "portfolio-reports", "spatial_reviews": "spatial-reviews",
            "customer_reviews": "reviews", "customer_review_responses": "review-responses",
            "observation_comparisons": "observation-comparisons",
        }
        if kind in immutable:
            return self._get(immutable[kind], key)
        mutable = {
            "grids": ("grids", "grid.json"),
            "runs": ("runs", "run.json"),
            "scenario_analyses": ("analyses", "summary.json"),
            "spatial_exports": ("spatial-exports", "export.json"),
            "comparisons": ("comparisons", "comparison.json"),
            "deliveries": ("deliveries", "delivery-state.json"),
        }
        if kind not in mutable:
            raise ValueError("Unknown retained record kind: " + str(kind))
        key = identifier(key)
        folder, filename = mutable[kind]
        value = read_json(self.root / folder / key / filename)
        if value.get("id") != key:
            raise ValueError("Retained " + kind + " item identity changed")
        return value

    def sources(self):
        return self._list("sources")

    @verified_operation
    def import_sources(self, manifest):
        if isinstance(manifest, (str, Path)):
            manifest_path = Path(manifest).resolve(strict=True)
            value = read_json(manifest_path)
            source_root = manifest_path.parent
            original = retain_file(self.root, manifest_path)
        else:
            raise ValueError("Import the retained source manifest from a local file")
        if value.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or not isinstance(value.get("entries"), list):
            raise ValueError("Source manifest must use upstate.sources/v1 and list entries")
        entries, seen = [], set()
        for row in value["entries"]:
            row = dict(row)
            name = row.get("id")
            if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or name in seen:
                raise ValueError("Each source edition needs a unique nonempty source ID")
            seen.add(name)
            if not row.get("uri") or not row.get("vintage") or not row.get("title"):
                raise ValueError("Source " + name + " needs its original URI, vintage and title")
            if row.get("kind") not in ("raster", "vector", "table", "document"):
                raise ValueError("Source kind must be raster, vector, table or document")
            source_name = row.pop("path")
            selected_companions = row.pop("companions", [])
            source_names = [source_name] + [item["path"] for item in selected_companions]
            native_names = [Path(name).as_posix() for name in source_names]
            if any("\\" in name or "\0" in name for name in native_names):
                raise ValueError("Native source paths must use portable relative names")
            # Preserve native sidecar/reference relationships within this entry.
            # Old source editions without view_path continue to use filename.
            common_parent = Path(os.path.commonpath([str(Path(name).parent) for name in native_names]))
            view_names = [Path(name).relative_to(common_parent).as_posix() for name in native_names]
            if len(set(view_names)) != len(view_names):
                raise ValueError("Native source paths collide")
            path = relative_file(source_root, source_name)
            body = {**retain_file(self.root, path, row.pop("sha256", None)),
                    "source_path": source_name, "view_path": view_names[0]}
            companions = []
            for companion, view_name in zip(selected_companions, view_names[1:]):
                cp = relative_file(source_root, companion["path"])
                companions.append({**retain_file(self.root, cp, companion.get("sha256")),
                                   "source_path": companion["path"], "view_path": view_name})
            entries.append({**row, "body": body, "companions": companions})
        return self._save("sources", {"title": value.get("title", "Source edition"),
                                      "captured_at": value.get("captured_at"),
                                      "original_manifest": original, "entries": entries,
                                      "notes": value.get("notes", []),
                                      "scope": value.get("scope", {})})

    @verified_operation
    def source_file(self, collection_id, source_id):
        collection = self._get("sources", collection_id)
        found = [e for e in collection["entries"] if e["id"] == source_id]
        if len(found) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Select an existing source ID in the retained source edition")
        entry = found[0]
        view = self.root / "source-views" / collection_id / digest(source_id)
        view.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with held(self.root / "objects" / (".source-view-" + collection_id + "-" + digest(source_id) + ".lock")):
            for body in [entry["body"]] + entry["companions"]:
                checksum = identifier(body["sha256"])
                with held(self.root / "objects" / (".intake-" + checksum + ".lock")):
                    original = relative_file(self.root, body["object"])
                    if not _retained_object_matches(original, checksum, body["bytes"]):
                        raise ValueError("Original scientific source changed: " + source_id)
                    name = body.get("view_path", body["filename"])
                    member = Path(name)
                    if (member.is_absolute() or not member.parts or ".." in member.parts
                            or member.as_posix() != name or "\\" in name or "\0" in name):
                        raise ValueError("Invalid native source member path")
                    target = view / member
                    if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(view.resolve()) or target.is_symlink():
                        raise ValueError("Native source view escapes its retained directory")
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    if not _retained_object_matches(target, checksum, body["bytes"]):
                        pending = None
                        candidate = target.parent / (".source-view-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
                        try:
                            try:
                                os.link(original, candidate)
                                pending = candidate
                            except FileExistsError:
                                raise
                            except OSError:
                                with original.open("rb") as src, tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                                        dir=target.parent, prefix=".source-view-", delete=False) as out:
                                    pending = Path(out.name)
                                    shutil.copyfileobj(src, out, 1024 * 1024)
                                    out.flush()
                                    os.fsync(out.fileno())
                            if not _retained_object_matches(pending, checksum, body["bytes"]):
                                raise ValueError("Original source changed during native view creation")
                            # Views are derived, not immutable source editions.
                            # Reconnect a damaged old hard link after CAS repair.
                            os.replace(pending, target)
                            # rename may be a no-op when a concurrent legacy
                            # writer linked this same inode to the final name.
                            pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                            pending = None
                            _sync_directory(target.parent)
                        finally:
                            if pending is not None:
                                pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                                _sync_directory(target.parent)
                    if not _retained_object_matches(target, checksum, body["bytes"]):
                        raise ValueError("Native source view differs: " + source_id)
        return view / entry["body"].get("view_path", entry["body"]["filename"]), entry

    @verified_operation
    def save_profile(self, value):
        value, active = normalize_selection(value)
        parameters = checked_parameters(value)
        collection = identifier(value["source_collection_id"])
        table_path, table_entry = self.source_file(collection, value["biophysical_source_id"])
        if table_entry["kind"] != "table":
            raise ValueError("Select the original biophysical CSV source")
        table = inspect_table(table_path, selected_models=active)
        value.update(parameters, table_summary={"columns": table["columns"], "lucodes": table["lucodes"],
                                                "rows": len(table["rows"]), "sha256": table_entry["body"]["sha256"]})
        return self._save("profiles", value)

    @verified_operation
    def save_scenario(self, value):
        value = scenario_spec(dict(value))
        collection = identifier(value["source_collection_id"])
        for patch in value.get("patches", []):
            _, entry = self.source_file(collection, patch["mask_source_id"])
            if entry["kind"] not in ("vector", "raster"):
                raise ValueError("Scenario masks must be retained polygons or aligned binary rasters")
        return self._save("scenarios", value)

    @verified_operation
    def prepare_grid(self, spec):
        from . import rasters
        from pyproj import CRS
        spec, active = normalize_selection(spec)
        roles = required_roles(active)
        collection_id = identifier(spec["source_collection_id"])
        inputs = spec["input_sources"]
        if not isinstance(inputs, dict):
            raise ValueError("Select the actual source IDs for the chosen native models")
        missing_roles = [role for role in roles if not inputs.get(role)]
        if missing_roles:
            raise ValueError("Selected models require source roles: " + ", ".join(missing_roles))
        reference, _ = self.source_file(collection_id, inputs["NLCD"])
        import rasterio
        with rasterio.open(reference) as ref:
            crs = CRS.from_user_input(ref.crs)
        def geometry(selection):
            p, entry = self.source_file(collection_id, selection["source_id"])
            rows, _ = rasters.vector_geometry(p, layer=selection.get("layer") or entry.get("layer"),
                                               where=selection.get("where"), target_crs=crs)
            return rasters.polygon_union(rows)
        reporting = geometry(spec["reporting_area"])
        model_core = geometry(spec["model_domain"])
        buffer_m = float(spec["upstream_buffer_m"])
        if not 0 <= buffer_m < 1000000:
            raise ValueError("Specify the actual nonnegative model-context buffer in metres")
        if not model_core.buffer(1e-5).covers(reporting):
            raise ValueError("Model-domain source must cover the full selected reporting basin")
        model_geometry = model_core if buffer_m == 0 else model_core.buffer(buffer_m)
        grid = rasters.grid_definition(
            reference, model_geometry, resolution=spec.get("resolution_m"))
        grid = retain_grid_definition(self, spec, grid)
        key = digest({"spec": spec, "grid": grid})
        directory = self.root / "grids" / key
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        state_path = directory / "grid.json"
        with held(directory / ".grid.lock", blocking=False):
            if state_path.exists():
                state = read_json(state_path)
                if state.get("state") == "complete":
                    for item in state["files"].values():
                        verify_file(directory, item)
                    return state
            else:
                state = {"schema": "upstate.grid/v1", "id": key, "state": "building",
                         "created_at": now(), "spec": spec, "grid": grid, "files": {}, "inputs": {}}
                atomic_json(state_path, state)
            state = reuse_grid_inputs(self, state, directory, active)
            if state.get("reused_inputs"):
                atomic_json(state_path, state)
            for name, geometry_value in (("model_domain", model_geometry), ("reporting_area", reporting)):
                if name not in state["files"]:
                    path = directory / (name + ".gpkg")
                    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    rasters.write_geometry(path, geometry_value, crs, layer=name,
                                            title=spec.get("title", name))
                    state["files"][name] = describe_file(directory, path)
                    atomic_json(state_path, state)
            if "reporting_mask" not in state["files"]:
                path = directory / "reporting_mask.tif"
                rasters.write_mask(path, grid, reporting)
                state["files"]["reporting_mask"] = describe_file(directory, path,
                                                               units="mask", selection="pixel centre")
                atomic_json(state_path, state)
            expected_units = {"DEM": "m", "NLCD": "class",
                              "R_FACTOR": "MJ*mm/(ha*h*year)",
                              "K_FACTOR": "t*ha*h/(ha*MJ*mm)"}
            for role in roles:
                if role in state["files"]:
                    verify_file(directory, state["files"][role])
                    continue
                path, entry = self.source_file(collection_id, inputs[role])
                if entry["kind"] != "raster":
                    raise ValueError(role + " requires a prepared source raster")
                conversion = entry.get("conversion")
                actual_units = conversion.get("target_units") if conversion else entry.get("units")
                if role in expected_units and actual_units != expected_units[role]:
                    raise ValueError(role + " requires declared units " + expected_units[role] +
                                     "; retain any conversion and its source reference")
                output = directory / (role.lower() + ".tif")
                checkpoint_directory = directory / ".alignment" / role.lower()
                stats = rasters.align_source(
                    path, output, grid, categorical=role == "NLCD",
                    resampling=entry.get("resampling"), conversion=conversion,
                    checkpoint_directory=checkpoint_directory,
                    source_identity={"collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
                                     "body": entry["body"], "companions": entry["companions"]})
                if role in ("R_FACTOR", "K_FACTOR") and stats["minimum"] is not None and stats["minimum"] < 0:
                    raise ValueError(role + " contains negative physical values")
                state["files"][role] = describe_file(directory, output, units=actual_units)
                state["inputs"][role] = {"source_id": entry["id"], "source_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
                                         "source_uri": entry["uri"], "vintage": entry["vintage"], **stats}
                atomic_json(state_path, state)
                # The complete, hashed TIFF is now retained by grid.json.
                # Remove only its rebuildable tiles after that durable record.
                shutil.rmtree(checkpoint_directory, ignore_errors=True)
            state.update(state="complete", completed_at=now())
            atomic_json(state_path, state)
            return state

    def get_grid(self, key):
        key = identifier(key)
        grid = read_json(self.root / "grids" / key / "grid.json")
        if grid.get("state") != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Finish the selected grid preparation")
        if digest({"spec": grid["spec"], "grid": grid["grid"]}) != key:
            raise ValueError("Selected grid definition changed")
        roles = required_roles(grid_models(grid))
        missing = [role for role in roles
                   if role not in grid.get("files", {}) or role not in grid.get("inputs", {})]
        if missing:
            raise ValueError("Selected grid lacks completed input roles: " + ", ".join(missing))
        return grid

    @verified_operation
    def prepare_run(self, selection):
        profile = self._get("profiles", selection["profile_id"])
        scenario = self._get("scenarios", selection["scenario_id"])
        from .scenario_footprint import validate_destination_codes
        validate_destination_codes(profile, scenario)
        grid = self.get_grid(selection["grid_id"])
        selection, active = normalize_selection(selection, default=grid_models(grid))
        if not set(active).issubset(grid_models(grid)):
            raise ValueError("Prepare the selected native models on this grid or extend its original inputs")
        if not set(active).issubset(selected(profile)):
            raise ValueError("Select a profile containing the chosen native model parameters and table fields")
        missing_inputs = [role for role in required_roles(active) if role not in grid["files"]]
        if missing_inputs:
            raise ValueError("The grid lacks the selected prepared inputs: " + ", ".join(missing_inputs))
        available = {int(x) for x in grid["inputs"]["NLCD"]["class_counts"]}
        missing = available - set(profile["table_summary"]["lucodes"])
        if missing:
            raise ValueError("Biophysical table lacks land-cover codes " + ", ".join(map(str, sorted(missing))))
        value = {"schema": "upstate.run-selection/v1", "grid_id": grid["id"],
                 "profile_id": profile["id"], "scenario_id": scenario["id"],
                 "invest_version": INVEST_VERSION}
        value, _ = normalize_selection(value, default=active)
        key = digest(value)
        directory = self.root / "runs" / key
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with held(directory / ".prepare.lock"):
            state = directory / "run.json"
            if not state.exists():
                atomic_json(state, {"schema": "upstate.run/v1", "id": key, "selection": value,
                                    "state": "prepared", "created_at": now(), "stages": {}, "artifacts": {}})
        return read_json(directory / "run.json")

    def inspect_run(self, key):
        identifier(key)
        value = read_json(self.root / "runs" / key / "run.json")
        if digest(value["selection"]) != key:
            raise ValueError("Original run selection changed")
        validate_completed_run(value)
        return value

    def run(self, key, *, reuse_source_run_ids=None):
        from .native import execute_run
        return execute_run(self, identifier(key), reuse_source_run_ids=reuse_source_run_ids)

    def combine_runs(self, selection, source_runs, *, execute=True):
        from .run_assembly import combine_runs
        return combine_runs(self, selection, source_runs, execute=execute)

    def compare_runs(self, ids):
        from .native import compare_runs
        return compare_runs(self, ids)

    def analyze_scenarios(self, selection):
        from .scenario_analysis import analyze
        return analyze(self, selection)

    def import_observations(self, path, metadata):
        from .observations import ingest
        return ingest(self, path, metadata)

    def compare_observations(self, run_id, observation_id, catchments):
        from .observations import compare
        return compare(self, run_id, observation_id, catchments)

    def delivery_preparations(self):
        """Open named preparation history without starting GIS or a delivery."""
        from .delivery_preparation import DeliveryPreparations
        return DeliveryPreparations(self)

    def build_delivery(self, selection):
        from .delivery import build
        return build(self, selection)

    def import_community_table(self, selection):
        from .communities import import_table
        return import_table(self, selection)

    def save_community_plan(self, selection):
        from .communities import save_plan
        return save_plan(self, selection)

    def build_community_report(self, selection):
        from .community_reports import build
        return build(self, selection)

    def build_planning_inventory(self, selection):
        from .planning_inventory import build
        return build(self, selection)

    def preview_portfolio(self, selection):
        from .portfolios import preview
        return preview(self, selection)

    def save_portfolio(self, selection):
        from .portfolios import save_portfolio
        return save_portfolio(self, selection)

    def prepare_portfolio_scenario(self, selection):
        from .portfolios import prepare_scenario
        return prepare_scenario(self, selection)

    def prepare_portfolio_run(self, selection):
        portfolio = self._get("portfolios", selection["portfolio_id"])
        context = portfolio["context"]
        grid_id = selection.get("grid_id") or context["grid_id"]
        if grid_id != context["grid_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Use the portfolio's original reporting grid for its selected parcel scenario")
        profile_id = selection.get("profile_id") or context["profile_id"]
        baseline = self.inspect_run(context["baseline_run_id"])
        active = selection.get("models", list(run_models(baseline)))
        scenario = self.prepare_portfolio_scenario(selection)
        return self.prepare_run({"grid_id": grid_id, "profile_id": profile_id,
                                 "scenario_id": scenario["id"], "models": active})

    def run_portfolio(self, selection):
        prepared = self.prepare_portfolio_run(selection)
        return self.run(prepared["id"])

    def build_portfolio_report(self, selection):
        from .portfolios import build_report
        return build_report(self, selection)

    def build_portfolio_decision(self, selection):
        from .portfolios import build_decision_report
        return build_decision_report(self, selection)

    def backup(self, destination, *, include_intermediates=True):
        """A complete self-contained project; native run caches can be selected."""
        from .portable import backup
        return backup(self, destination, include_intermediates=include_intermediates)
