"""Cold-open the geographic project using its own archived application.

The existing native receiving operation owns this invocation. This helper opens
saved native results, sources, the scientific report and customer review only.
It does not execute a model or rebuild a scientific product.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from contextlib import contextmanager
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HELPER = "source_tools/geographic_headwaters_reopen.py"
SCHEMA = "upstate.geographic-headwaters-cold-receiving/v1"


@contextmanager
def receiving_lock(path):
    """Keep the original receiving flock alive in a surviving owned child."""
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        yield descriptor
    finally:
        # Do not explicitly LOCK_UN: a child can still own this open description.
        os.close(descriptor)


def _support():
    if str(APP) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(APP))
    from source_tools import simulated_headwaters_receiving
    if Path(simulated_headwaters_receiving.__file__).resolve() != APP / "source_tools/simulated_headwaters_receiving.py":
        raise ValueError("Use the retained scientific receiving implementation")
    return simulated_headwaters_receiving


def _lock_identity(descriptor, path):
    if type(descriptor) is not int:
        raise ValueError("Retain the original receiving lock descriptor")
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    opened, current = os.fstat(descriptor), path.lstat()
    if (not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode)
            or (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (current.st_dev, current.st_ino)):
        raise ValueError("The receiving lock path differs from its owned descriptor")
    return {"path": str(path), "device": opened.st_dev, "inode": opened.st_ino}


def _scientific_identity(scientific):
    selection, report = scientific["selection"], scientific["report"]
    return {
        "source_operation_id": scientific["id"], "source": scientific["source"],
        "ensemble_id": scientific["ensemble_id"], "report_id": selection["report_id"],
        "summary_signature": selection["summary_signature"],
        "run_signature": selection["run_signature"], "report_signature": report["signature"],
        "figure_count": scientific["figure_count"],
    }


def cold_reopen(restored, manifest, prepared, scientific, delivery_id, review_id,
                output, *, receiving_lock_fd, receiving_lock_path,
                review_response_id=None, receiving_context=None, scenario_context=None,
                reference_basis=None, programme=None, geographic_gis=None):
    """Retain and run one complete read-only cold-reopen invocation."""
    support = _support()
    root = Path(restored["directory"]).resolve(strict=True)
    application = Path(restored["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
    workspace = Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
    if application != root / "application" or workspace != root / "workspace":
        raise ValueError("Select the archived application and Workspace together")
    if (restored["project"] != manifest["project"]
            or prepared["project_id"] != manifest["project"]["id"]
            or scientific["workspace_id"] != prepared["project_id"]
            or scientific["ensemble_id"] != prepared["ensemble_id"]):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original geographic project and scientific selection")
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if (output.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(output)
            or output.is_relative_to(APP) or APP.is_relative_to(output)):
        raise ValueError("Keep cold invocation history outside both application editions")
    lock_identity = _lock_identity(receiving_lock_fd, receiving_lock_path)
    attempt = uuid.uuid4().hex
    directory = output / attempt
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    request_path, result_path = directory / "request.json", directory / "result.json"
    stdout_path, stderr_path = directory / "stdout.log", directory / "stderr.log"
    process = None
    started = support._now()
    try:
        if "application/" + HELPER not in manifest["members"]:
            raise ValueError("The delivered archive must contain its geographic cold receiver")
        snapshots = support._application(application, manifest["members"])
        request = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "attempt_id": attempt, "started_at": started,
            "application": str(application), "workspace": str(workspace),
            "project": manifest["project"], "members": manifest["members"],
            "archive_sha256": restored["archive_sha256"],
            "archive_delivery": manifest.get("delivery"),
            "prepared": prepared, "scientific": _scientific_identity(scientific),
            "delivery_id": delivery_id, "review_id": review_id,
            "review_response_id": review_response_id,
            "receiving_context": receiving_context,
            "scenario_context": scenario_context,
            "reference_basis": reference_basis,
            "geographic_programme": programme,
            "geographic_gis": geographic_gis,
            "receiving_lock": lock_identity,
        }
        support._write(request_path, request)
        request_sha = hashlib.sha256(request_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        command = [
            sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(application / HELPER),
            "--request", str(request_path), "--request-sha256", request_sha,
            "--result", str(result_path), "--lock-fd", str(receiving_lock_fd),
        ]
        support._write(directory / "launch.json", {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "attempt_id": attempt, "started_at": started,
            "command": command, "request_sha256": request_sha,
            "archive_sha256": restored["archive_sha256"],
            "source_members": len(snapshots), "receiving_lock": lock_identity,
        })
        _lock_identity(receiving_lock_fd, receiving_lock_path)
        with stdout_path.open("xb", buffering=0) as stdout, stderr_path.open("xb", buffering=0) as stderr:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                command, cwd=application, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                pass_fds=(receiving_lock_fd,))
            returncode = process.wait()
            os.fsync(stdout.fileno())
            os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
        if returncode:
            raise RuntimeError("Archived geographic application exited "
                               + str(returncode) + "; inspect " + str(stderr_path))
        result = support._read(result_path)
        if (result.get("schema") != SCHEMA or result.get("attempt_id") != attempt
                or result.get("state") != "complete" or result.get("project") != manifest["project"]
                or result.get("request_sha256") != request_sha
                or result.get("geographic_edition_id") != prepared["id"]
                or result.get("archive_sha256") != restored["archive_sha256"]
                or result.get("application") != str(application)
                or result.get("workspace") != str(workspace)
                or result.get("reference_basis") != reference_basis
                or result.get("geographic_programme") != programme
                or result.get("geographic_gis") != geographic_gis):
            raise ValueError("Cold receiving returned a different source, project or invocation")
        for name, identity in snapshots.items():
            if support._identity(support._member(application, name).lstat()) != identity:
                raise ValueError("Archived application changed during receiving: " + name)
        return {**result, "attempt_directory": str(directory),
                "request": str(request_path), "stdout": str(stdout_path),
                "stderr": str(stderr_path), "result": str(result_path), "returncode": returncode}
    except BaseException as error:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            try:
                process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait()
            except OSError as cleanup_error:
                support._secondary(error, "stop owned receiving child", cleanup_error)
        try:
            support._write(directory / "parent-failure.json", {
                "schema": SCHEMA, "attempt_id": attempt, "started_at": started,
                "failed_at": support._now(),
                "state": "failed" if isinstance(error, Exception) else "interrupted",
                "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)},
                "returncode": process.returncode if process is not None else None,
                "stdout": str(stdout_path), "stderr": str(stderr_path),
            })
        except OSError as receipt_error:
            support._secondary(error, "retain receiving failure", receipt_error)
        raise


def _reference_course(ws, files, prepared, basis):
    """Open one complete reference trio and the original unfinished full design."""
    from source_tools.geographic_archive import reference_snapshot
    support = _support()
    snapshot = reference_snapshot(ws, prepared, basis)
    for item in snapshot["members"].values():
        files.file(ws.root, item)
    plan = snapshot["plan"]
    reference_ids = basis["reference_run_ids"]
    states = {}
    for member in plan["members"]:
        files.json("profiles/" + member["profile_id"] + ".json")
        profile = ws._get("profiles", member["profile_id"])
        support._sources(ws, files, profile["source_collection_id"])
        scenarios = [plan["baseline_scenario_id"], *plan["alternative_scenario_ids"]]
        if [item["scenario_id"] for item in member["runs"]] != scenarios:
            raise ValueError("The received reference snapshot changed a planned scenario order")
        for item in member["runs"]:
            key = item["run_id"]
            saved = files.json("runs/" + key + "/run.json")
            run = ws.inspect_run(key)
            expected = {"grid_id": plan["grid_id"], "profile_id": member["profile_id"],
                        "scenario_id": item["scenario_id"]}
            if saved != run or any(run["selection"].get(name) != value for name, value in expected.items()):
                raise ValueError("The received reference snapshot changed an original native selection")
            states[key] = run["state"]
            if run["state"] == "complete":
                support._run(ws, files, key, expected)
            elif key in reference_ids:
                raise ValueError("The selected original reference run is not complete")
            else:
                files.descriptors(ws.root / "runs" / key, run.get("artifacts", {}))
    support._comparison(ws, files, basis["comparison_id"], reference_ids)
    return {"kind": "reference_course_snapshot", "ensemble_id": plan["id"],
            "completion_scope": "reference", "reference_state": "reference_complete",
            "course_state": basis["course_state"], "native_runs": len(reference_ids),
            "planned_native_runs": len(states), "reference_run_ids": reference_ids,
            "completed_run_ids": sorted(key for key, state in states.items() if state == "complete"),
            "pending_run_ids": sorted(key for key, state in states.items() if state != "complete"),
            "native_progress": basis["native_progress"], "pending_members": basis["pending_members"],
            "paired_products": snapshot["paired_products"]}


def _inspect(request, lock_fd):
    if request.get("schema") != SCHEMA:
        raise ValueError("Use the retained geographic receiving request")
    application = Path(request["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
    if APP != application or Path(__file__).resolve() != application / HELPER:
        raise ValueError("Run the geographic helper inside the delivered application")
    lock = _lock_identity(lock_fd, request["receiving_lock"]["path"])
    if lock != request["receiving_lock"]:
        raise ValueError("The child inherited another receiving lock")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(application))
    importlib.invalidate_caches()
    support = _support()
    from model.workspace import Workspace
    import model.workspace as workspace_module
    if Path(workspace_module.__file__).resolve() != application / "model/workspace.py":
        raise ValueError("The child imported another Workspace implementation")
    ws = Workspace(Path(request["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True))
    files = support._ScienceFiles(ws, request["members"])
    if files.json("workspace.json") != request["project"] or ws.project != request["project"]:
        raise ValueError("The delivered project identity changed")
    prepared = request["prepared"]
    saved = files.json("geographic-headwaters/" + prepared["id"] + "/prepared.json")
    if saved != prepared:
        raise ValueError("The delivered geographic preparation changed")
    case = {**prepared, "scientific_study": request["scientific"]}
    reference_basis = request.get("reference_basis")
    if reference_basis is not None:
        original_delivery = request.get("archive_delivery")
        original = (original_delivery or {}).get("files", {}).get("handover_record")
        if not original or original.get("path") != "delivery/handover-record.json":
            raise ValueError("Retain the reference opening page inside this original archive")
        expected = request["members"].get(original["path"])
        if expected is None or any(original.get(key) != expected[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("The reference opening record differs from its archived descriptor")
        path = support._member(ws.root.parent, original["path"])
        before = support._check_file(path, expected)
        handover = support._read(path)
        if (handover.get("reference_basis") != reference_basis
                or handover.get("prepared") != prepared
                or handover.get("scientific", {}).get("id") != request["scientific"]["source_operation_id"]
                or handover.get("delivery_id") != request["delivery_id"]
                or support._identity(path.lstat()) != before):
            raise ValueError("The archived opening page changed its selected reference edition")
    parameter = (support._parameter_course(ws, files, {"ensemble_id": prepared["ensemble_id"]}, case)
                 if reference_basis is None else _reference_course(ws, files, prepared, reference_basis))
    runs = [prepared["baseline_run_id"], *prepared["alternative_run_ids"]]
    scenarios = [prepared["baseline_scenario_id"], *prepared["alternative_scenario_ids"]]
    if len(runs) != len(scenarios) or len(set(runs)) != len(runs):
        raise ValueError("Retain distinct original run/scenario selections")
    for key, scenario in zip(runs, scenarios):
        support._run(ws, files, key, {
            "grid_id": prepared["grid_id"], "profile_id": prepared["profile_id"],
            "scenario_id": scenario})
    for key in (prepared["source_collection_id"],
                request["scientific"]["source"]["source_collection_id"]):
        support._sources(ws, files, key)
    delivery_id = request["delivery_id"]
    files.json("deliveries/" + delivery_id + "/delivery-state.json")
    delivery = ws.retained_item("deliveries", delivery_id)
    if (delivery["state"] != "complete"
            or delivery["selection"]["baseline_run_id"] != runs[0]
            or delivery["selection"]["scenario_run_ids"] != runs[1:]):
        raise ValueError("The delivered mapped report belongs to another selection")
    files.descriptors(ws.root / "deliveries" / delivery_id, delivery["files"])
    files.descriptors(ws.root / "deliveries" / delivery_id, delivery["maps"])
    scientific = support._native_study_source(ws, files, {
        "ensemble_id": prepared["ensemble_id"],
        "source_operation_id": request["scientific"]["source_operation_id"],
        "expected": request["scientific"]}, case, delivery, reference_basis=reference_basis)
    context = request.get("receiving_context")
    expected_source_ids = {
        prepared["source_collection_id"], request["scientific"]["source"]["source_collection_id"]}
    if context is not None:
        from model import geographic_receiving_context as utility_context
        context_id = context["id"]
        retained_context = files.json(utility_context.FOLDER + "/" + context_id + "/context.json")
        if retained_context != context or utility_context.inspect(ws, context_id) != context:
            raise ValueError("The delivered original utility context changed")
        if (context["prepared_id"] != prepared["id"]
                or context["baseline_run_id"] != runs[0]
                or context["alternative_run_ids"] != runs[1:]):
            raise ValueError("The delivered utility context belongs to another native case")
        from model import observed_context
        chosen_sources = observed_context.source_choices(delivery["selection"])
        for item in context["analyses"]:
            if chosen_sources.count(item["source"]) != 1:
                raise ValueError("The delivered report omits or duplicates an original utility analysis")
        for key in utility_context.source_collection_ids(context):
            support._sources(ws, files, key)
            expected_source_ids.add(key)
    interpretation = request.get("scenario_context")
    if interpretation is not None:
        from source_tools import geographic_scenario_context as source_context
        original_context = files.json(source_context.FOLDER + "/" + interpretation["id"] + "/context.json")
        if original_context != interpretation or source_context.inspect(ws, interpretation["id"]) != interpretation:
            raise ValueError("The delivered original source-loading context changed")
        if (interpretation["prepared_id"] != prepared["id"]
                or interpretation["ensemble_id"] != prepared["ensemble_id"]):
            raise ValueError("The interpreted source belongs to another geographic case")
        from model import observed_context
        if observed_context.source_choices(delivery["selection"]).count(interpretation["source"]) != 1:
            raise ValueError("The delivered mapped report omits its original source-loading interpretation")
        key = interpretation["source"]["source_collection_id"]
        support._sources(ws, files, key)
        expected_source_ids.add(key)
    programme = request.get("geographic_programme")
    programme_verification = None

* **Mechanism separation (WO-18–21/25):** distinguish source-coefficient changes, downslope retention, erosion cover/support factors and combined interventions. Hold the effective routed nutrient source fixed when isolating retention; keeping a raw application-rate field constant may still change its effective loading when efficiency changes.

* **Observed-load dimensions (WO-12/13):** for matching intervals with C in mg/L, Q in cubic metres/second and duration in seconds, interval load in kg is C × Q × duration /1000. A flow-weighted mean concentration in mg/L is1000 × total load in kg / total volume in cubic metres. Use documented load/trend methods such as LOADEST or WRTDS/EGRET only when their input/support requirements are met. Keep useful descriptive observations available when a particular fitted analysis lacks data.
* **Held-out fitting (WO-27):** decide spatial/time partitions before fitting, keep preprocessing and parameter selection inside training, and preserve a genuine held-out evaluation. Report exact constituent/catchment/period, errors and parameter equifinality. Do not repeatedly tune to the held-out target or absorb omitted point sources/impoundment processes into arbitrary land-cover coefficients.
* **Downstream budgets (WO-29/30):** represent incoming/outgoing mass, water volume, storage and transformations explicitly. Keep particle settling, dissolved nutrient processes, added sources and channel erosion separate where modeled. A stream-export annual total is not an instantaneous intake concentration; any average needs its actual matching water volume/support.

files.source_tools/multivariate_control_receiv:
"""Continue one authored matched-control study in the original geographic receiver.

This module is called by receive_geographic_headwaters.py. Its direct entry point
only reopens an already restored study with the source contained in that archive.
Native design, matching, adoption and execution remain in model.multivariate_control.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(APP) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(APP))

from model.common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, identifier, now, read_json, verify_file
from model.workspace import Workspace
from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_reopen import receiving_lock, _lock_identity

SCHEMA = "upstate.multivariate-control-receiving/v1"
REOPEN = "upstate.multivariate-control-cold-reopen/v1"
HELPER = "source_tools/multivariate_control_receiving.py"


def _event(stage, **details):
    print(json.dumps({"stage": stage, **details}, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)


def _outside(path, root):
    if path == root or path.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(path):
        raise ValueError("Keep matched-control receiving output outside the application and Workspace")


def _original_runs(workspace):
    """Snapshot completed original records without inventing or changing a run."""
    records = []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / "runs").glob("*/run.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        if value.get("state") == "complete":
            if value.get("id") != path.parent.name:
                raise ValueError("A completed original run changed its content identity")
            records.append({"id": value["id"], "selection": value["selection"],
                            "record": describe_file(workspace.root, path)})
    return records


def _preserve_original_runs(workspace, originals):
    for row in originals:
        path = verify_file(workspace.root, row["record"])
        value = read_json(path)
        if (value.get("id") != row["id"] or value.get("state") != "complete"
                or value.get("selection") != row["selection"]):
            raise ValueError("The matched-control continuation changed an original completed run")
    return {"completed_originals": len(originals), "identity": "MATCH"}


def _archive(workspace, output, selection):
    from model import study_transfer
    path = output / "matched-control-study.zip"
    receipt_path = output / "study-archive.json"
    if path.exists():
        inspected = study_transfer.inspect_transfer_archive(path, verify=True)
        if inspected["study"]["identity"]["selection"] != study_transfer.normalise(selection):
            raise ValueError("The retained archive belongs to another authored matched-control study")
        if inspected["manifest"]["project"] != workspace.project:
            raise ValueError("The retained archive belongs to another Workspace")
        if receipt_path.exists():
            receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
            if receipt["id"] != inspected["study"]["id"]:
                raise ValueError("The retained archive receipt changed its selected study")
            if receipt.get("sha256") != file_digest(path):
                raise ValueError("The retained selected Study ZIP differs from its original receipt")
            return receipt, inspected
        # An export can publish its complete archive before its caller saves the ACK.
        # Reconcile that exact original ZIP; never replace it with another selection.
        receipt = {"id": inspected["study"]["id"], "path": str(path),
                   "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(path),
                   "recovered_complete_archive": True}
    else:
        receipt = study_transfer.export_study(
            workspace, path, selection,
            progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-study-export", **value))
        inspected = study_transfer.inspect_transfer_archive(path, verify=True)
    atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt, immutable=True)
    return receipt, inspected


def _restore(output, archive, project):
    from model import portable
    destination = output / "received"
    receipt_path = output / "study-restore.json"
    if destination.exists():
        restored = portable.resume_restore(
            archive["path"], destination, expected_archive_sha256=archive["sha256"])
    else:
        restored = portable.restore(archive["path"], destination)
    if (restored["archive_sha256"] != archive["sha256"]
            or restored["project"] != project
            or Path(restored["application"]).resolve() != destination / "application"
            or Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve() != destination / "workspace"):
        raise ValueError("The received matched-control study changed its original archive or project")
    # Native resume may add its reconciliation status. Retain the first full receipt,
    # and keep the latest native reconciliation as a separate current result.
    if not receipt_path.exists():
        atomic_json(receipt_path, restored, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(output / "study-restore-current.json", restored)
    return restored


def _cold_reopen(restored, inspected, design, output, lock_fd, outcome=None):
    """Run the archive's own source in a clean Python process."""
    from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_reopen import _support
    support = _support()
    application = Path(restored["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
    workspace = Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
    members = inspected["manifest"]["members"]
    if "application/" + HELPER not in members:
        raise ValueError("The selected Study must include its original matched-control receiving chapter")
    source_identity = support._application(application, members)
    attempt = uuid.uuid4().hex
    directory = output / "cold-reopen" / attempt
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    request = {"schema": REOPEN, "attempt_id": attempt,
               "application": str(application), "workspace": str(workspace),
               "project": restored["project"], "archive_sha256": restored["archive_sha256"],
               "study_id": inspected["study"]["id"], "design": design,
               **({"outcome": outcome} if outcome is not None else {}),
               "receiving_lock": _lock_identity(lock_fd, output / ".matched-control-receiving.lock")}
    request_path = directory / "request.json"
    result_path = directory / "result.json"
    atomic_json(request_path, request, immutable=True)
    request_sha = file_digest(request_path)
    command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(application / HELPER),
               "--reopen-request", str(request_path), "--request-sha256", request_sha,
               "--result", str(result_path), "--lock-fd", str(lock_fd)]
    atomic_json(directory / "launch.json",
                {"schema": REOPEN, "command": command, "started_at": now(),
                 "request_sha256": request_sha, "source_members": len(source_identity)},
                immutable=True)
    process = None
    try:
        with (directory / "stdout.log").open("xb", buffering=0) as stdout, \
                (directory / "stderr.log").open("xb", buffering=0) as stderr:
            process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=application, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                       pass_fds=(lock_fd,))
            _event("matched-control-cold-process", pid=process.pid, command=command)
            code = process.wait()
            os.fsync(stdout.fileno())
            os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
        if code:
            raise RuntimeError("The contained matched-control application exited "
                               + str(code) + "; inspect " + str(directory / "stderr.log"))
        result = read_json(result_path)
        if (result.get("schema") != REOPEN or result.get("attempt_id") != attempt
                or result.get("request_sha256") != request_sha or result.get("identity") != "MATCH"
                or result.get("project") != restored["project"]
                or result.get("study_id") != inspected["study"]["id"]
                or result.get("design_id") != design["id"]
                or (outcome is not None and result.get("outcome_id") != outcome["id"])):
            raise ValueError("The contained application returned another saved design or Study")
        for name, identity in source_identity.items():
            if support._identity(support._member(application, name).lstat()) != identity:
                raise ValueError("The contained application source changed during cold reopening")
        return {**result, "attempt_directory": str(directory), "returncode": code,
                "stdout": str(directory / "stdout.log"), "stderr": str(directory / "stderr.log")}
    except BaseException:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        raise


def reopen(request_path, request_sha256, result_path, lock_fd):
    request_path = Path(request_path).resolve(strict=True)
    if file_digest(request_path) != identifier(request_sha256):
        raise ValueError("The cold-reopen request changed")
    request = read_json(request_path)
    if request.get("schema") != REOPEN or Path(request["application"]).resolve() != APP:
        raise ValueError("Use the source contained in the selected original Study archive")
    lock = request["receiving_lock"]
    if _lock_identity(lock_fd, lock["path"]) != lock:
        raise ValueError("The contained application lost the original receiving lock")
    workspace = Workspace(Path(request["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True))
    if workspace.project != request["project"]:
        raise ValueError("The contained Workspace is not the selected original project")
    from model import multivariate_control, study_transfer
    verification = study_transfer.verify_received_studies(workspace)
    if request["study_id"] not in {row["id"] for row in verification}:
        raise ValueError("The native selected-study receiver lost the original design root")
    found = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, request["design"]["id"])
    if found != request["design"]:
        raise ValueError("Cold reopening changed the retained design, adoption or native result")
    outcome = None
    if request.get("outcome") is not None:
        from model import multivariate_control_outcomes
        outcome = multivariate_control_outcomes.inspect(workspace, request["outcome"]["id"])
        if outcome != request["outcome"]:
            raise ValueError("Cold reopening changed the exact native outcome report, support or source")
    result = {"schema": REOPEN, "attempt_id": request["attempt_id"],
              "request_sha256": request_sha256, "project": workspace.project,
              "study_id": request["study_id"], "design_id": found["id"],
              **({"outcome_id": outcome["id"]} if outcome is not None else {}),
              "identity": "MATCH", "verified_studies": verification, "completed_at": now()}
    atomic_json(Path(result_path), result, immutable=True)
    return result


def _browser_admission(restored, study_id, design, outcome=None):
    """Pin the received native Study for the existing browser course."""
    root = Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
    members = ["workspace.json", "study-transfers/" + identifier(study_id) + ".json",
               "multivariate-controls/" + identifier(design["id"]) + "/design.json"]
    if design.get("adoption"):
        members.append("multivariate-controls/" + design["id"] + "/adoption.json")
    if outcome is not None:
        members.append("multivariate-control-outcomes/" + identifier(outcome["id"]) + "/outcome.json")
    runs = []
    for path in sorted((root / "runs").glob("*/run.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        if value.get("id") != path.parent.name:
            raise ValueError("The received run differs from its original identifier")
        members.append(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
        runs.append({"id": value["id"], "state": value["state"]})
    return {"schema": "upstate.multivariate-control-browser-admission/v1",
            "project": restored["project"], "archive_sha256": restored["archive_sha256"],
            "application": restored["application"], "workspace": restored["workspace"],
            "study_id": study_id, "design_id": design["id"],
            **({"outcome_id": outcome["id"]} if outcome is not None else {}),
            "run_records": runs,
            "files": [describe_file(root, root / name) for name in members]}


def receive(workspace, output, *, selection_path=None, design_id=None, execute=False,
            prepared_id=None, outcome_selection_path=None):
    """Optional chapter of the maintained geographic receiving runner."""
    from model import multivariate_control, scenario_footprint, study_transfer
    if (selection_path is None) == (design_id is None):
        raise ValueError("Supply exactly one authored selection file or saved matched-control design ID")
    if type(execute) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("Choose explicitly whether to execute the new matched-control native case")
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    _outside(output, workspace.root)
    _outside(output, APP)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with receiving_lock(output / ".matched-control-receiving.lock") as lock_fd:
        if selection_path is not None:
            body = Path(selection_path).resolve(strict=True).read_bytes()
            selected = json.loads(body)
            atomic_bytes(output / "original-selection.json", body, immutable=True)
            proposed = multivariate_control.preview(workspace, selected)
            atomic_json(output / "preview.json", proposed)
            requested = {"selection_sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}
        else:
            requested = {"design_id": identifier(design_id)}
            selected = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)["selection"]
        outcome_requested = {}
        outcome_selection = None
        if outcome_selection_path is not None:
            body = Path(outcome_selection_path).resolve(strict=True).read_bytes()
            outcome_selection = json.loads(body)
            from model import multivariate_control_outcomes
            multivariate_control_outcomes.normalize(outcome_selection)
            atomic_bytes(output / "original-outcome-selection.json", body, immutable=True)
            outcome_requested["outcome_selection_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
        baseline = workspace.inspect_run(identifier(selected["baseline_run_id"]))
        footprint = scenario_footprint.get_footprint(
            workspace, identifier(selected["restoration_footprint_id"]))
        if baseline["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Receive a completed original baseline before a new control study")
        restoration = workspace.inspect_run(footprint["run_id"])
        if restoration["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Receive the completed original restoration used by this design")
        if prepared_id is not None:
            prepared_id = identifier(prepared_id)
            prepared = read_json(workspace.root / "geographic-headwaters" / prepared_id / "prepared.json")
            if (prepared["project_id"] != workspace.project["id"]
                    or prepared["id"] != prepared_id or prepared["baseline_run_id"] != baseline["id"]
                    or restoration["id"] not in prepared["alternative_run_ids"]):
                raise ValueError("The design does not use the selected original Geographic baseline and restoration")
        identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "project_id": workspace.project["id"], **requested, **outcome_requested,
                    "prepared_id": prepared_id, "execute": execute,
                    "baseline_run_id": baseline["id"], "restoration_run_id": restoration["id"]}
        operation_id = digest(identity)
        state_path = output / "receiving.json"
        if state_path.exists():
            state = read_json(state_path)
            if state.get("identity") != identity or state.get("id") != operation_id:
                raise ValueError("Resume the same authored matched-control chapter in this output directory")
        else:
            state = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": operation_id, "identity": identity,
                     "original_completed_runs": _original_runs(workspace),
                     "created_at": now(), "stages": {}}
            atomic_json(state_path, state)

        def save(**value):
            state.update(value, updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(state_path, state)

        def phase(name, action):
            _preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"])
            started = time.perf_counter()
            save(state="running", active_stage=name)
            _event(name, operation_id=operation_id, state="running")
            try:
                result = action()
                _preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"])
            except BaseException as error:
                save(state="failed" if isinstance(error, Exception) else "interrupted",
                     error={"stage": name, "type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
                raise
            previous = state["stages"].get(name, {})
            state["stages"][name] = {"state": "complete",
                "first_completed_at": previous.get("first_completed_at", now()),
                "first_elapsed_seconds": previous.get("first_elapsed_seconds", time.perf_counter()-started),
                "latest_elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started}
            state.pop("error", None)
            save(active_stage=None)
            return result

        if design_id is None:
            design = phase("matched-control-prepare",
                           lambda: multivariate_control.prepare(workspace, selected,
                               progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-design-progress", progress=value)))
            design_id = design["id"]
        else:
            design = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)
        save(design_id=design_id, design_state=design["state"])
        atomic_json(output / "design.json", design)
        if design["state"] == "prepared":
            adopted = phase("matched-control-adopt", lambda: multivariate_control.adopt(workspace, design_id))
            save(adoption=adopted["adoption"])
            if execute:
                def execute_control():
                    from model import experiments
                    result = multivariate_control.execute(workspace, design_id)
                    atomic_json(output / "native-experiment.json", result)
                    summary = experiments.read_summary(workspace, adopted["adoption"]["experiment_id"])
                    if summary is not None:
                        atomic_json(output / "native-summary.json", summary)
                    if result.get("state") != "complete":
                        raise ValueError("The original matched-control experiment is not complete; inspect its retained progress and resume this same chapter")
                    return result
                execution = phase("matched-control-native", execute_control)
                save(execution=execution)
        else:
            # Infeasible and threshold-rejected assessments are complete scientific
            # records. Export their full treatment/support evidence without adoption.
            save(interpretation="No accepted control design; the full original treatment remains retained.",
                 native_execution="not_adopted")
        design = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)
        atomic_json(output / "design.json", design)
        outcome = None
        if outcome_selection is not None:
            if design_id not in outcome_selection["design_ids"]:
                raise ValueError("Include this exact original saved design in the authored outcome group")
            from model import multivariate_control_outcomes
            outcome_preview = phase("matched-control-outcome-preview",
                                    lambda: multivariate_control_outcomes.preview(workspace, outcome_selection))
            atomic_json(output / "outcome-preview.json", outcome_preview)
            originals = _original_runs(workspace)
            outcome = phase("matched-control-outcome-report",
                            lambda: multivariate_control_outcomes.prepare(workspace, outcome_selection,
                                progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-outcome-progress", progress=value)))
            if _original_runs(workspace) != originals:
                raise ValueError("The native outcome report changed or added a completed model run")
            if outcome["id"] != outcome_preview["id"]:
                raise ValueError("The prepared outcome left the exact original preview")
            atomic_json(output / "outcome.json", outcome)
            save(outcome_report=outcome, outcome_id=outcome["id"])
        transfer_selection = {
            "schema": study_transfer.SELECTION_SCHEMA,
            "title": selected["title"] + " — editable matched-control study",
            "roots": [{"kind": "multivariate-controls", "id": design_id}]
                     + ([{"kind": "multivariate-control-outcomes", "id": outcome["id"]}] if outcome is not None else []),
            "include_related_results": True,
        }
        preview = phase("matched-control-study-preview",
                        lambda: study_transfer.preview(workspace, transfer_selection))
        atomic_json(output / "study-preview.json", preview)
        archive, inspected = phase("matched-control-study-export",
                                  lambda: _archive(workspace, output, transfer_selection))
        save(archive=archive, study_id=inspected["study"]["id"])
        restored = phase("matched-control-study-restore",
                         lambda: _restore(output, archive, workspace.project))
        save(restored=restored)
        cold = phase("matched-control-contained-reopen",
                     lambda: _cold_reopen(restored, inspected, design, output, lock_fd, outcome))
        save(state="complete", active_stage=None, design=design, independent_reopen=cold,
             browser_admission=_browser_admission(restored, inspected["study"]["id"], design, outcome),
             preserved_originals=_preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"]),
             outcome=design["state"],
             producer_view="Pending actual desktop/narrow operation and viewing of every outgoing attachment.")
        return state


def main(argv=None):
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read-only contained matched-control Study reopening")
    parser.add_argument("--reopen-request", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--request-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--lock-fd", type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

"""Exact, scalable one-dimensional precipitation subset matching.

The smaller target population is injected into distinct candidate cells, minimizing
sum(abs(target - candidate)). Sorting is O((n+m) log(n+m)); diagonal separation is
O(n log(m-n+1)) time and O(n+m) storage, without a pairwise matrix. See the adjacent
MATCHED_CONTROL_MATCHING.md for the scientific contract and tie convention.

Algorithm: Aggarwal, Bar-Noy, Khuller, Kravets and Schieber, CS-TR-3199,
section 4 (bitonic Monge arrays). This is an original NumPy implementation.
https://hdl.handle.net/1903/610
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
from typing import Callable, Any

import numpy as np

METHOD = "class-stratified-exact-monge-L1-dyadic/v1"
TIE_RULE = "sorted-value-id; symbolic target=3*i+1, candidate=3*j; first prefix minimum"
_CHUNK = 262_144  # Temporary-array size only; every input cell is processed.
_INT_LIMIT = 1 << 61


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Matching:
    """Positions refer to the caller's original arrays, not sorted ordinals."""
    candidate_positions: np.ndarray
    target_order: np.ndarray
    target_count: int
    candidate_count: int
    objective_integer: int
    objective_binary_exponent: int
    arithmetic: str
    separator_rows: int
    separators: int

    def metadata(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            objective = math.ldexp(float(self.objective_integer), self.objective_binary_exponent)
            if not math.isfinite(objective):
                objective = None
        except OverflowError:
            objective = None
        return {
            "method": METHOD, "tie_rule": TIE_RULE,
            "target_cells": self.target_count, "eligible_candidate_cells": self.candidate_count,
            "objective_sum_absolute_precipitation_residual_mm_year": objective,
            "exact_objective": {"integer": str(self.objective_integer),
                                "binary_exponent": self.objective_binary_exponent},
            "arithmetic": self.arithmetic, "separator_rows": self.separator_rows,
            "separators": self.separators,
            "optimization": "global minimum total absolute precipitation residual",
            "matching_scope": "one already-selected original land-cover class",
        }


def _check(callback: Callable[[], None] | None) -> None:
    if callback is not None:
        callback()  # Exceptions propagate; the caller owns its checkpoint/queue.


def _values(value: Any, label: str) -> np.ndarray:
    arr = np.asarray(value)
    if arr.ndim != 1 or arr.dtype.kind not in "fiu":
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a one-dimensional real numeric array")
    if arr.dtype.kind == "f" and arr.dtype.itemsize > 8:
        raise ValueError(f"{label}: explicitly choose float64 before matching higher-precision inputs")
    if arr.dtype.kind in "iu" and arr.size and (
            int(arr.min()) < -(1 << 53) or int(arr.max()) > (1 << 53)):
        raise ValueError(f"{label}: integer coordinates must be exactly representable in float64")
    arr = np.asarray(arr, dtype=np.float64)
    if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
        raise ValueError(f"{label} contains nonfinite precipitation; resolve source support first")
    if np.any(arr < 0):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} contains negative precipitation")
    return arr


def _ids(value: Any, count: int, label: str) -> np.ndarray:
    if value is None:
        return np.arange(count, dtype=np.int64)
    arr = np.asarray(value)
    if arr.ndim != 1 or arr.size != count or arr.dtype.kind not in "iu":
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must contain one integer original cell ID per value")
    if arr.size and (int(arr.min()) < 0 or int(arr.max()) > np.iinfo(np.int64).max):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be nonnegative signed-64-bit cell IDs")
    arr = np.asarray(arr, dtype=np.int64)
    if count > 1 and not np.all(arr[1:] > arr[:-1]) and np.unique(arr).size != count:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} contains duplicate original cell IDs")
    return arr


def _binary_unit(arrays: tuple[np.ndarray, ...], callback: Callable[[], None] | None) -> int:
    """Smallest binary unit represented by the actual IEEE-754 input values."""
    unit = None
    for array in arrays:
        for start in range(0, array.size, _CHUNK):
            _check(callback)
            bits = array[start:start + _CHUNK].view(np.uint64)
            exponent = ((bits >> np.uint64(52)) & np.uint64(2047)).astype(np.int64)
            significand = bits & np.uint64((1 << 52) - 1)
            significand = significand | ((exponent != 0).astype(np.uint64) << np.uint64(52))
            nonzero = significand != 0
            if not np.any(nonzero):
                continue
            sig = significand[nonzero]
            # The isolated low bit is a power of two and converts to float exactly.
            low = sig & (~sig + np.uint64(1))
            trailing = np.frexp(low.astype(np.float64))[1].astype(np.int64) - 1
            e = exponent[nonzero]
            powers = np.where(e == 0, -1074, e - 1075) + trailing
            local = int(powers.min())
            unit = local if unit is None else min(unit, local)
    return 0 if unit is None else unit


def _coordinates(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray, callback: Callable[[], None] | None
                 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, int, str]:
    unit = _binary_unit((a, b), callback)
    maximum = max(float(a.max(initial=0)), float(b.max(initial=0)))
    try:
        scaled_maximum = math.ldexp(maximum, -unit)
    except OverflowError:
        scaled_maximum = math.inf
    # Nonnegative coordinates <=2**61 guarantee safe signed differences. Prefix
    # absolute differences are bounded by the telescoping candidate value range.
    fast = scaled_maximum <= _INT_LIMIT
    converted = []
    for arr in (a, b):
        out = np.empty(arr.size, dtype=np.int64 if fast else object)
        for start in range(0, arr.size, _CHUNK):
            _check(callback)
            stop = min(arr.size, start + _CHUNK)
            if fast:
                scaled = np.ldexp(arr[start:stop], -unit)
                out[start:stop] = scaled.astype(np.int64)
            else:
                for j in range(start, stop):
                    numerator, denominator = float(arr[j]).as_integer_ratio()
                    shift = -(denominator.bit_length() - 1) - unit
                    out[j] = numerator << shift if shift >= 0 else numerator >> (-shift)
        converted.append(out)
    return converted[0], converted[1], unit, "int64-dyadic" if fast else "python-integer-dyadic"


def _exact_sum(arr: np.ndarray) -> int:
    total = 0
    for start in range(0, arr.size, _CHUNK):
        part = arr[start:start + _CHUNK]
        if part.dtype == object or (part.size and int(part.max()) * part.size > np.iinfo(np.int64).max):
            total += sum(map(int, part))
        else:
            total += int(part.sum(dtype=np.int64))
    return total


def match_precipitation(target_values: Any, candidate_values: Any, *,
                        target_ids: Any = None, candidate_ids: Any = None,
                        check_running: Callable[[], None] | None = None) -> Matching:
    """Match all targets to distinct candidates with the exact minimum L1 cost.

    Input values are finite, nonnegative float64 precipitation in mm/year. IDs
    are unique nonnegative original cell indices within each population. This
    primitive does not choose geographic/corridor/class support: its caller must
    supply that support and must enforce disjoint target/candidate populations.
    Empty target classes are valid. Insufficient candidates raise ValueError.

    No user input is rounded, binned or perturbed. Symbolic secondary coordinates
    only choose among exactly equal primary objectives. Legacy DP tie-selected
    cell identities may differ: retain existing completed editions unchanged.
    """
    _check(check_running)
    targets = _values(target_values, "targets")
    candidates = _values(candidate_values, "candidates")
    n, m = targets.size, candidates.size
    if n > m:
        raise ValueError(f"Insufficient disjoint candidates: {m} available for {n} targets")
    ti = _ids(target_ids, n, "target_ids")
    ci = _ids(candidate_ids, m, "candidate_ids")
    if not n:
        empty = np.empty(0, dtype=np.int64)
        return Matching(empty, empty, 0, m, 0, 0, "int64-dyadic", 0, 0)
    # Secondary prefix arithmetic is also exact. This bound is far beyond grids
    # that fit in addressable arrays, but reject rather than allow int64 overflow.
    if 12 * n * (m + n + 1) >= np.iinfo(np.int64).max:
        raise OverflowError("Symbolic tie-coordinate population exceeds signed-64-bit accumulation")
    _check(check_running)
    to = np.lexsort((ti, targets))
    co = np.lexsort((ci, candidates))
    a, b, exponent, arithmetic = _coordinates(targets[to], candidates[co], check_running)
    selected = np.empty(n, dtype=np.int64)
    # Process the disjoint recursion nodes a level at a time. Every level is
    # vectorized; there is no Python loop per target cell or candidate pair.
    starts = np.array([0], dtype=np.int64)
    stops = np.array([n], dtype=np.int64)
    lefts = np.array([0], dtype=np.int64)
    rights = np.array([m - n], dtype=np.int64)
    rows_visited = separators = 0
    while starts.size:
        _check(check_running)
        lengths = stops - starts
        group_starts = np.concatenate((np.array([0], dtype=np.int64), np.cumsum(lengths[:-1])))
        rows = np.arange(int(lengths.sum()), dtype=np.int64) + np.repeat(starts - group_starts, lengths)
        fixed = lefts == rights
        if np.any(fixed):
            fixed_rows = np.repeat(fixed, lengths)
            selected[rows[fixed_rows]] = rows[fixed_rows] + np.repeat(lefts, lengths)[fixed_rows]
            if np.all(fixed):
                break
            starts, stops, lefts, rights = (v[~fixed] for v in (starts, stops, lefts, rights))
            lengths = stops - starts
            group_starts = np.concatenate((np.array([0], dtype=np.int64), np.cumsum(lengths[:-1])))
            rows = np.arange(int(lengths.sum()), dtype=np.int64) + np.repeat(starts - group_starts, lengths)
        middle = (lefts + rights) // 2
        offsets = np.repeat(middle, lengths)
        j = rows + offsets
        rows_visited += int(rows.size)
        separators += int(starts.size)
        x, lo, hi = a[rows], b[j], b[j + 1]
        # A full diagonal is cost(i, i+offset). The prefix minimizer of adjacent
        # diagonal differences is the separating row (CS-TR-3199, section 4.2).
        prefix = np.cumsum(np.abs(x - lo) - np.abs(x - hi))
        before = np.concatenate((np.array([0], dtype=prefix.dtype), prefix[group_starts[1:] - 1]))
        primary = prefix - np.repeat(before, lengths)
        # The scanned candidate gaps are disjoint and ascending even across
        # groups. Their total bounds every primary prefix by b[-1]-b[0], so
        # int64 accumulation cannot overflow under _coordinates' range bound.
        # Distinct symbolic coordinates resolve repeated-value plateaus without
        # rounding/perturbing any actual precipitation: target (value,3*i+1),
        # candidate (value,3*j). Secondary diagonal costs depend only on offset.
        d_lo = 1 - 3 * offsets
        d_hi = d_lo - 3
        secondary_lo = np.where(x == lo, np.abs(d_lo), np.where(x > lo, d_lo, -d_lo))
        secondary_hi = np.where(x == hi, np.abs(d_hi), np.where(x > hi, d_hi, -d_hi))
        prefix_secondary = np.cumsum(secondary_lo - secondary_hi, dtype=np.int64)
        before_secondary = np.concatenate((np.array([0], dtype=np.int64), prefix_secondary[group_starts[1:] - 1]))
        secondary = prefix_secondary - np.repeat(before_secondary, lengths)
        minimum = np.minimum(np.minimum.reduceat(primary, group_starts), 0)
        eligible = primary == np.repeat(minimum, lengths)
        sentinel = np.iinfo(np.int64).max
        secondary_minimum = np.minimum.reduceat(np.where(eligible, secondary, sentinel), group_starts)
        empty = (minimum == 0) & (secondary_minimum >= 0)
        minima = eligible & (secondary == np.repeat(secondary_minimum, lengths))
        first_rows = np.minimum.reduceat(np.where(minima, rows, sentinel), group_starts)
        splits = np.where(empty, starts, first_rows + 1)
        # Interleave left/right children in row order; completed rows disappear
        # naturally. This preserves the disjoint-gap bound on the next level.
        next_starts = np.column_stack((starts, splits)).ravel()
        next_stops = np.column_stack((splits, stops)).ravel()
        next_lefts = np.column_stack((lefts, middle + 1)).ravel()
        next_rights = np.column_stack((middle, rights)).ravel()
        keep = next_starts < next_stops
        starts, stops, lefts, rights = (v[keep] for v in (next_starts, next_stops, next_lefts, next_rights))
    if n > 1 and not np.all(selected[1:] > selected[:-1]):
        raise RuntimeError("Internal matching invariant: candidate positions are not strictly increasing")
    objective = _exact_sum(np.abs(a - b[selected]))
    positions = np.empty(n, dtype=np.int64)
    positions[to] = co[selected]
    return Matching(positions, to, n, m, objective, exponent, arithmetic, rows_visited, separators)

Preparation uses retained original geography and ordinary Workspace APIs.
--run continues the existing native parameter course and exports its real report.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(APP) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(APP))

from model.common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, held, now, read_json
from model.workspace import Workspace
from model import geographic_headwaters as geographic

from source_tools.demo_deadline import CUTOFF, DemoDeadlineReached, check_cutoff, cutoff_guard
from source_tools.geographic_archive import (retained_prepared, retained_reference_prepared,
                                             retained_execution_prepared, retained_workspace_prepared,
                                             retain_binding, verify_archive)
from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_handover import prepare as prepare_handover


def _outside(path, root):
    if path.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(path):
        raise ValueError("Keep receiving output separate from the application and Workspace")


def _scientific_source(workspace, ensemble_id, output):
    """Reuse the verified complete source edition without rewriting its operation.

    The maintained producer decides whether its source/result signatures remain
    current. Changed signatures still receive a new ordinary producer edition.
    Every selected snapshot is retained before advancing the receiving pointer.
    """
    from model import ensemble_study_source as study_source

    scientific = study_source.latest(workspace, ensemble_id, verify=True)
    if (scientific is None or scientific.get("state") != "complete"
            or scientific.get("source_state") != "current"):
        scientific = study_source.prepare(workspace, ensemble_id, render=True)
    if scientific.get("state") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("Continue the original ensemble scientific source until complete")
    # Verify the selected complete operation and all of its existing native
    # source/report members after a prepare as well as during a retained reopen.
    verified = study_source.latest(workspace, ensemble_id, verify=True)
    if verified != scientific or verified.get("source_state") != "current":
        raise ValueError("The selected scientific source advanced during receiving; retain this original attempt and reopen")
    pointer = Path(output) / "scientific-source.json"
    for value in ([read_json(pointer)] if pointer.exists() else []) + [scientific]:
        if (value.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"]
                or value.get("ensemble_id") != ensemble_id
                or value.get("id") != digest(value.get("selection"))):
            raise ValueError("Retained scientific snapshot belongs to another original study")
        atomic_json(Path(output) / "scientific-editions" / value["id"]
                    / (digest(value) + ".json"), value, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(pointer, scientific)
    return scientific


def _geographic_programme(workspace, output, prepared, delivery):
    """Retain the original completed-output adoption before any archive capture."""
    from model import geographic_programme

    scope = {"project_id": workspace.project["id"], "geographic_id": prepared["id"],
             "existing_delivery_id": delivery["id"]}
    target = Path(output) / "programme-editions" / (digest(scope) + ".json")
    previous = read_json(target) if target.exists() else None
    pointer = Path(output) / "geographic-programme.json"
    old = read_json(pointer) if pointer.exists() else None
    if old is not None:
        if (old.get("schema") != geographic_programme.SCHEMA
                or old.get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]):
            raise ValueError("Retain the original programme output in its own receiving project")
        atomic_json(Path(output) / "programme-history" / (digest(old) + ".json"),
                    old, immutable=True)

            previous = old
    programme = geographic_programme.adopt(
        workspace, prepared["id"], delivery_id=delivery["id"], previous=previous)
    if any(programme.get(key) != value for key, value in scope.items()):
        raise ValueError("The adopted programme changed its original geographic delivery")

    atomic_json(target, programme, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(pointer, programme)

            or scientific.get("ensemble_id") != prepared["ensemble_id"]

            or digest({key: value for key, value in manifest.items()
                       if key != "package_sha256"}) != exported["package_sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("Select the original complete reference customer review export")
    review_packet = read_json(review_root / "review.json")
    if review_packet.get("latest_response_id") != exported["latest_response_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The reference review response generation changed")
    for name, item in manifest["members"].items():
        retain("review", review_root, {"path": name, **item})
    retain("review", review_root, describe_file(review_root, review_root / "review-manifest.json"))
    value = {
        "schema": "upstate.geographic-reference-report-edition/v1",
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "prepared_id": prepared["id"],
        "ensemble_id": prepared["ensemble_id"], "report_state": "complete",
        "native_course_state": course["state"],
        "scope": "Completed original reference profile and alternatives; the full selected "
                 "sensitivity course and its actual pending members remain retained.",
        "prepared": deepcopy(prepared), "reference_basis": deepcopy(basis),
        "parameter_course": deepcopy(course), "reference_runs": deepcopy(runs),
        "scientific": deepcopy(scientific), "delivery": deepcopy(delivery),

        "files": [inventory[key] for key in sorted(inventory)],
        "helper_sha256": file_digest(Path(__file__)),
    }
    edition = {"id": digest(value), **value}
    target = Path(output) / "reference-reports" / edition["id"] / "edition.json"
    atomic_json(target, edition, immutable=True)
    return {

        "reference_basis": deepcopy(basis), "scientific_source_id": scientific["id"],
        "scientific_files": deepcopy(scientific["report"]["files"]),
        "delivery_id": delivery["id"], "delivery_files": deepcopy(delivery["files"]),

def _retain_geographic_checkpoint(args, error):
    """Preserve the same original receiving record at the owner's native cutoff."""
    output = args.output.resolve()
    receipt = output / "receiving.json"
    original = {}
    read_error = None
    if receipt.is_file():
        try:
            original = read_json(receipt)
            if original.get("schema") != "upstate.geographic-headwaters-receiving/v1":
                raise ValueError("The receiving receipt has another original schema")
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as problem:
            read_error = {"type": type(problem).__name__, "message": str(problem)}
            original = {}
    checkpoint = {
        "schema": "upstate.geographic-headwaters-checkpoint/v1",
        "cutoff": CUTOFF.isoformat(), "stopped_at": now(),
        "state": "cutoff" if isinstance(error, DemoDeadlineReached) else "interrupted",
        "workspace": str(args.workspace.resolve()), "output": str(output),
        "source_receipt": str(receipt) if receipt.exists() else None,
        "operation_id": original.get("operation_id"),
        "project_id": original.get("project_id"),
        "active_stage": original.get("active_stage"),
        "recorded_state": original.get("state"),
        "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)},
        "retained_receiving": original,
    }
    if read_error is not None:
        checkpoint["receipt_read_error"] = read_error
    atomic_json(output / "geographic-checkpoint.json", checkpoint)
    return checkpoint


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--import-sources",type=Path,action="append",default=[])
    parser.add_argument("--selection",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--node",default="node",help="Actual equipped Node executable for the maintained complete source-loading report")
    adoption = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    adoption.add_argument("--workspace-preparation",help="Receive this actual saved geographic preparation by ID, with a new current receiving admission and no historical CLI claim")
    adoption.add_argument("--adopt-prepared",action="store_true",help="Execute the original retained preparation under its unchanged admission after explicit source adoption; use only with --run-reference or --run")
    adoption.add_argument("--adopt-handover",action="store_true",help="Use the completed original preparation under its retained admission for report-only handover source adoption")
    adoption.add_argument("--adopt-reference-report",action="store_true",help="Adopt report-only receiving for the original completed reference trio while its full native course keeps its actual state")
    modes = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    modes.add_argument("--catalog",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--preview",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--prepare-only",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--run",action="store_true")
    modes.add_argument("--run-reference",action="store_true",help="Run/reuse only the original first native trio, retain its complete reference handover, and leave the existing sensitivity course for explicit continuation")
    modes.add_argument("--report-only",action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--reference-handover",action="store_true",help="Include a separate reference-scoped full project archive and cold receiving for an actual partial course report")
    matched = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    matched.add_argument("--matched-control-selection", type=Path,
                         help="Continue one authored multivariate-control selection in the existing Workspace")
    matched.add_argument("--matched-control-id",
                         help="Receive an exact saved multivariate-control design, retaining its original choices")
    parser.add_argument("--execute-matched-control", action="store_true",
                        help="Execute only the newly adopted control through the original experiment")
    parser.add_argument("--matched-geographic-id",
                        help="Require exact baseline/restoration membership in this retained Geographic preparation")
    parser.add_argument("--matched-control-outcome-selection", type=Path,
                        help="Prepare an authored completed-control outcome group and retain it in the same received Study")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.matched_control_selection or args.matched_control_id:
        if (args.selection or args.import_sources or args.workspace_preparation
                or args.adopt_prepared or args.adopt_handover or args.adopt_reference_report
                or args.reference_handover or any((args.catalog, args.preview, args.prepare_only,
                                                args.run, args.run_reference, args.report_only))):
            parser.error("Use the optional matched-control chapter with its own explicit selection or ID; preserve the original Geographic course separately")
        if args.output is None:
            parser.error("--output is required for the matched-control chapter")
        from source_tools.multivariate_control_receiving import receive as receive_matched_control
        result = receive_matched_control(
            Workspace(args.workspace), args.output,
            selection_path=args.matched_control_selection, design_id=args.matched_control_id,
            execute=args.execute_matched_control, prepared_id=args.matched_geographic_id,
            outcome_selection_path=args.matched_control_outcome_selection)
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
        return 0
    if (args.execute_matched_control or args.matched_geographic_id
            or args.matched_control_outcome_selection):
        parser.error("Choose --matched-control-selection or --matched-control-id first")
    if args.workspace_preparation and not (args.report_only or args.run_reference or args.run):
        parser.error("--workspace-preparation requires --report-only, --run-reference or --run")
    if args.workspace_preparation and args.import_sources:
        parser.error("--workspace-preparation receives the existing retained source collections; import new sources separately")
    if args.reference_handover and not args.report_only:
        parser.error("--reference-handover requires --report-only; --run-reference already retains that handover")
    if args.adopt_prepared and not (args.run_reference or args.run):
        parser.error("--adopt-prepared requires explicit --run-reference or --run")
    if (args.adopt_handover or args.adopt_reference_report) and not args.report_only:
        parser.error("Report adoption requires --report-only; native preparation keeps its original admitted source")
    if not (args.catalog or args.preview) and args.output is None:
        parser.error("--output is required for preparation or receiving")
    if args.catalog or args.preview:
        result = receive(args)
    else:
        try:
            with cutoff_guard():
                result = receive(args)
        except BaseException as error:
            if not isinstance(error, Exception):
                try:
                    _retain_geographic_checkpoint(args, error)
                except Exception as receipt_error:
                    if hasattr(error, "add_note"):
                        error.add_note("Geographic checkpoint write failed: " + str(receipt_error))
            raise
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
    return 2 if result.get("state") == "partial" else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

def original(path):
    body = Path(path).read_bytes()

            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
            "text": body.decode("utf-8")}



def _report_members(workspace, recommendation_id):

def _member_inventory(files):

def _evidence_roster(history):
    rows = []
    for proposal in history:
        for target in proposal["targets"]:
            evidence = target.get("model_evidence")
            if evidence is None:
                continue
            native, source = evidence["native"], evidence["source"]
            rows.append({"recommendation_id": proposal["id"], "target_id": target["target_id"],
                "selection": evidence["selection"], "source": source,
                "native_family": native["family"], "native_id": native["id"],
                "native_project_id": native["project_id"],
                "run_ids": native["run_ids"], "selected_quantity": native["selected_quantity"],
                "support": native["support"], "target_binding": evidence["target_binding"],
                "relation": evidence["relation"]})
    return rows


def _required_nodes(project_id, roster):
    nodes = set()
    for row in roster:
        source = row["source"]
        nodes.add(("sources", source["collection_id"]))
        if row["native_project_id"] == project_id:
            kind = ("multivariate-control-outcomes" if row["native_family"] == "control_outcomes"
                    else "terrain-conditioning-report-sources")
            nodes.add((kind, row["native_id"]))
            for run_id in row["run_ids"]:
                nodes.add(("runs", run_id))
    return [{"kind": kind, "id": key} for kind, key in sorted(nodes)]


def _extract_report(archive_path, destination, files):
    """Open every exact packet member and retain ordinary reviewable files."""
    import os
    import shutil
    import tempfile
    import zipfile
    from model.monitoring_packet import _member_name, _verify_existing
    from model.common import file_digest
    archive_path, destination = Path(archive_path), Path(destination)
    _verify_existing(archive_path, files)
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    root = destination.resolve()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        for name, member in sorted(files.items()):
            _member_name(name)
            target = destination / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("The report member left its retained receiving directory")
            if target.exists():
                if target.stat().st_size != member["bytes"] or file_digest(target) != member["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("Preserve the existing reviewed report file: " + name)
                continue
            temporary = None
            try:
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=target.parent, prefix=".receiving-", delete=False) as outgoing:
                    temporary = Path(outgoing.name)
                    with archive.open(name) as incoming:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(incoming, outgoing, length=1024 * 1024)
                    outgoing.flush()
                    os.fsync(outgoing.fileno())
                if temporary.stat().st_size != member["bytes"] or file_digest(temporary) != member["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("The extracted original report member differs: " + name)
                os.replace(temporary, target)
                temporary = None
            finally:
                if temporary is not None:
                    temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return str(destination / "sampling-review.html")
