# Multivariate matched-control designs

TokenJunkieLabs scientific engineering for the original Upper Savannah Workspace.
Current workflow: WO-19, ECO-MULTIVARIATE-CONTROLS-20261013. Original scientific method choices and interpretation remain with the prime.

## What the complete workflow does

Select an original baseline native run and an exact retained restoration footprint. Declare source-unit covariate boundaries and, optionally, an acceptance threshold for the prepared runoff proxy. The original exact one-dimensional Monge matcher selects distinct off-treatment control cells within each admitted original-class/covariate stratum. Save the full assessment, inspect remaining balance and missing support, and adopt an accepted design through the original source, scenario, native run and experiment writers.

The original baseline/restoration selections remain immutable. A different design gets its own saved ID, source collection, scenario, run and original experiment. Executing that original experiment reuses completed original cases; the control is the new native case. This module never replaces NDR/SDR, the original experiment queue or an existing control.

### Exact scientific scope

* The treatment population is every actual final baseline-to-restoration changed cell in the selected compiled footprint. A completed restoration must agree, cell for cell and support for support, with its retained native land-cover stage. A current compiler preview cannot silently replace an executed treatment.
* A successful design retains the entire original treatment count and from/to transition roster. Every treatment cell must lie in the original reporting mask and have every selected admission covariate. Missing support produces an unaccepted assessment; it does not shrink the design.
* Candidates are unchanged original cells inside the same reporting mask, of an original treatment class, outside the actual treatment and outside the optional explicit exclusion mask. Unknown exclusion support is excluded. Each control cell is used once.
* This first edition admits one destination code per original class. A treatment that changes one original class to competing destination classes is rejected explicitly before adoption; no independent matcher may reuse their shared candidate pool.
* Native DEM, R_FACTOR, K_FACTOR and PRECIPITATION values are the already-aligned and converted prepared grid. Their original source entries, classifications, source SHA, units, conversion and resampling history remain in input-binding.json. Conversion is not applied a second time.
* Optional SLOPE and CONNECTIVITY are explicitly chosen original single-band rasters on the exact native shape, CRS and affine transform. The analyst supplies real units and a physical definition. An unapplied conversion is rejected; select its original prepared output instead. DEM means elevation, not slope. A connectivity label alone never defines its physical quantity.
* Stratum boundaries are exact analyst-authored values. Bins are lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive, with unbounded outer bins; an exact edge enters the higher bin. An empty boundary list is one unconstrained bin and is labeled that way.
* The unchanged original matcher minimizes total absolute **prepared runoff-proxy** difference within each stratum. Metadata uses the actual source units. No per-stratum runoff normalization is introduced.
* The optional caliper is a post-match acceptance threshold for every selected pair. A failing selected unconstrained optimum gives **threshold_not_met**, which does not prove that no full caliper-feasible assignment exists. No target is removed and no threshold is relaxed.
* Exact class/area equality and stratification do not imply equal continuous covariates, equal slope/routing/connectivity, or a causal treatment effect. Every unstratified dimension remains named. The chosen land-cover transition changes the original corresponding coefficients and retention assumptions together.
* Separate record IDs or titles are not independent spatial placements. Compare the saved mask SHA values and original chosen cell IDs. New analyst-defined sources or boundaries can produce another placement; deterministic renaming supplies no extra simulation evidence.
* The matching preparation computes no pollutant reduction. Annual native N/P kg/year and sediment tonnes/year remain the original model results, with original common-support comparisons. They are modeled delivery to streams, not intake concentrations.

## Saved states

| State | Meaning | Available continuation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| prepared | Every original treatment cell matched, all declared pair thresholds passed | Inspect, download, adopt original scenario/experiment, selected Study transfer |
| infeasible | Exact current support has missing/outside treatment cells or an exact stratum has fewer admissible candidates than targets | Inspect the complete assessment and adjust an explicitly authored new selection |
| threshold_not_met | The selected unconstrained optimum exceeds the declared caliper | Inspect every pair and make an explicit new design choice; no mathematical impossibility claim |
| Interrupted computation | No immutable design.json published yet; progress remains in the owned design directory | Retry the exact original request or author a new resource/selection edition |

Only prepared permits adoption. Failed scientific assessments are successful retained products: their original inputs, unmatched roster, statistics, complete CSV/JSON and HTML remain downloadable and are imported as ordinary OBSERVED_CONTEXT report sources.

## Original command line

Run from the actual application directory with its native GIS interpreter:

```sh
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli catalog --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli preview --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --selection AUTHORED_SELECTION.json
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli prepare --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --selection AUTHORED_SELECTION.json
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli inspect --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --id RETURNED_DESIGN_ID
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli adopt --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --id ACCEPTED_DESIGN_ID
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli execute --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --id ADOPTED_DESIGN_ID
```

Execute is explicit; prepare and adopt do not execute native models. The queue uses the same functions through control.prepare, control.adopt and control.execute. Returned adoption identifies the exact original experiment, scenario, run, footprint and source collection. Use those returned IDs in the original Experiment/Programme controls; do not reconstruct native IDs or choose a default completed case.

Selection shape:

```json
{
  "schema": "upstate.multivariate-control-selection/v1",
  "title": "Author's named control design",
  "reason": "Author's scientific purpose and design rationale",
  "baseline_run_id": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_64_HEX_ID",
  "restoration_footprint_id": "ACTUAL_RETAINED_64_HEX_ID",
  "strata": [
    {"role": "DEM", "boundaries": [], "units": "m"}
  ],
  "precipitation_caliper": null,
  "exclusion_source": null,
  "max_working_bytes": 1073741824
}
```

This is a shape example, not an authored scientific design: the analyst must select original IDs, justified boundaries and a working-memory budget appropriate to the actual host. The empty boundaries explicitly impose no elevation constraint. No automatic quantiles, default thresholds, fabricated observations or silent optimizer substitutions are supplied.

For an optional source stratum use:

```json
{
  "role": "CONNECTIVITY",
  "boundaries": [],
  "units": "EXACT_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_UNITS",
  "definition": "The source's actual physical connectivity definition",
  "source": {
    "source_collection_id": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_64_HEX_ID",
    "source_id": "ACTUAL_SOURCE_ID",
    "source_sha256": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_64_HEX_SHA"
  }
}
```

The exclusion_source uses the same three source fields and a binary aligned band. Original source value1 excludes; zero admits; NoData does not admit a candidate. The original reporting mask still applies.

## Files and readable interpretation

The directory multivariate-controls/DESIGN_ID retains normalized selection, exact input binding and original records, original producer implementation, complete matching result, immutable assessment and source manifest. The normal report source contains all companions.

* report.html: directly usable offline complete assessment, with the exact declared boundaries/units/definitions, all strata and balance rows.
* assessment.json: complete source-bound machine-readable design.
* matched-pairs.csv: every proposed pair, exact original row-major cell identities, coordinates, transition and each available physical value/residual.
* unmatched-targets.csv: original targets outside reporting support, missing selected covariates, or in insufficient candidate strata.
* strata.csv: full original-class/covariate roster, target/candidate/pair counts and reasons.
* balance.csv: original target, candidate, selected control and paired residual moments, population SD, extrema and absolute residuals.
* Accepted control-FROM-to-TO.tif: exact original-grid binary scenario masks, with body SHA and counts.
* selection.json/input-binding.json/originals/implementation: actual choices and scientific source/code provenance.

Overall target/candidate moments use each field's finite pre-admission population. Per-stratum moments use fully admitted targets/candidates. Selected controls and paired residuals keep their actual finite count. In a rejected design these populations can differ; a mean must not be read as a matched-support effect.

The report is also an original OBSERVED_CONTEXT choice for the maintained Sources scientific composer. Append that choice to an ordered scientific edition without inventing a saved report ID. Native results, when later completed, are available through the original experiment report and common-support tools.

## Editable selected Study and complete Workspace

The typed root is multivariate-controls. Export through the original Study selector with an exact selected design ID. It carries the full original design assessment, source CAS, native grid/profile, original baseline/restoration runs, compiled footprint completion tree and, when adopted, the original control scenario/run/footprint and experiment plan/progress. It does not execute or reconstruct a design while receiving.

Selecting an original scientific report containing this exact source also follows the same typed design. Same-project sources must match complete native files; foreign original sources remain self-contained scientific documents and do not borrow local IDs. Original archives without this new root/source keep their historical receiving semantics.

Original full Workspace export remains supported. On the recipient, inspect the saved design ID, open all contained report/data/mask attachments, and reopen the same original experiment. Later legitimate native progress is retained by the original experiment/run machinery. Old completed controls and archived workspaces are never overwritten.

## Native and browser receiving

The existing geographic/native receiving owner consumes this complete source family and its optional matched-control chapter. Pass an explicitly authored selection; use the same restored original Workspace and retained native inputs. The native chapter returns actual design/adoption/experiment IDs, source-member identities, original selected-study export/restore result and the first real error if one occurs. Preserve running native handles and completed regional/teaching/38F0 cases; no duplicate original model run or new controller.

The actual outgoing operator must be used at desktop/screenshare and390px: choose original baseline/restoration, inspect source units, edit exact boundaries and optional source dimensions, preview, prepare, inspect every row/download, reopen a saved assessment, adopt only an accepted complete design, navigate its original experiment, then export/restore and reopen. Exercise invalid/missing choices and a scientifically unaccepted assessment as appropriate. The producer must personally open and view the resulting report, CSV, JSON, mask, archive contents and working recipient application. Captured-but-unviewed screenshots do not qualify. Repair concrete usability or receiving failures in this same course.

Source review and V8 controller checks are not native execution or rendered acceptance. This source-engineering seat has not claimed Python/GDAL or visual acceptance. The actual original equipped receiver owns that complete course.

## Current owner direction and attribution

The post-call44 work orders continue after the historical14UTC cutoff. This feature authorizes no external prospect message, payment, source purchase, contract signature, access-control change, private GitHub repository, hosted Actions or new fleet session.

"""Continue explicitly selected original report receiving operations in order.

This module is called only by the maintained receive_operator.py entrypoint.
Each item invokes that same receiver and retains its original output/task IDs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from model.common import atomic_json, digest, held, read_json
from model.workspace import Workspace

SCHEMA = "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-course/v1"


def _require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def _path(value, base):
    _require(isinstance(value, str) and value and "\0" not in value,
             "Course paths must be nonempty ordinary paths.")
    path = Path(value)
    return (path if path.is_absolute() else base / path).resolve()


def _at(value, path):
    _require(isinstance(path, list) and path and
             all(isinstance(key, str) and key for key in path),
             "A receipt selector is a nonempty list of original object keys.")
    for key in path:
        _require(isinstance(value, dict) and key in value,
                 "The original source receipt is missing " + ".".join(path))
        value = value[key]
    return value


def _validate(course):
    _require(isinstance(course, dict) and
             set(course) <= {"schema", "operation_id", "project_id", "steps"} and
             course.get("schema") == SCHEMA,
             "Use an original scientific-report-receiving-course/v1 manifest.")
    for name in ("operation_id", "project_id"):
        _require(isinstance(course.get(name), str) and course[name],
                 "Retain the course's original " + name + ".")
    steps = course.get("steps")
    _require(isinstance(steps, list) and steps, "Select at least one original report course.")
    prior = set()
    allowed = {"id", "origin", "depends_on", "output", "output_from_receipt",
               "manifest", "selection", "selection_file", "source_receipt",
               "title", "contact_json", "selected_study"}
    for item in steps:
        _require(isinstance(item, dict) and not set(item) - allowed,
                 "A course item contains an unsupported field.")
        key = item.get("id")
        _require(isinstance(key, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}", key)
                 and key not in prior, "Use distinct ordinary course item IDs.")
        _require(isinstance(item.get("origin"), str) and item["origin"],
                 "Retain each item's original accepted operation reference.")
        dependencies = item.get("depends_on", [])
        _require(isinstance(dependencies, list) and
                 all(isinstance(name, str) and name in prior for name in dependencies),
                 "Dependencies must name earlier original report items.")
        prior.add(key)
        _require(sum(name in item for name in
                     ("manifest", "selection", "selection_file", "source_receipt")) == 1,
                 "Each report item needs exactly one original source selection.")
        _require(("output" in item) != ("output_from_receipt" in item),
                 "Choose the original output path or its original receipt-bound suffix.")
        _require(isinstance(item.get("selected_study"), bool),
                 "Retain each original selected-study choice explicitly.")
        if "manifest" in item:
            _require(isinstance(item["manifest"], list) and item["manifest"] and
                     all(isinstance(path, str) and path for path in item["manifest"]),
                     "Keep original source manifests in reading order.")
        if "source_receipt" in item:
            source = item["source_receipt"]
            _require(isinstance(source, dict) and
                     set(source) <= {"path", "sources_path", "title_path", "checks"} and
                     "path" in source and "sources_path" in source,
                     "A source receipt needs its original file and source selector.")
            _require(isinstance(source.get("checks", []), list),
                     "Receipt checks must retain an ordered list.")
            for check in source.get("checks", []):
                _require(isinstance(check, dict) and set(check) == {"path", "equals"},
                         "Receipt checks retain an original field path and exact value.")
        if "output_from_receipt" in item:
            suffix = item["output_from_receipt"]
            _require("source_receipt" in item and isinstance(suffix, dict) and
                     set(suffix) == {"directory", "prefix", "path"} and
                     isinstance(suffix["prefix"], str) and
                     re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]*", suffix["prefix"]),
                     "Receipt-bound outputs use the original directory, prefix and ID field.")
    return steps


def _resolve_item(item, base, root, args, identity):
    options = argparse.Namespace(**vars(args))
    options.course = None
    options.create_workspace = False
    options.manifest = None
    options.selection = None
    options.title = item.get("title")
    options.contact_json = None
    options.selected_study = item["selected_study"]
    # Browser receiving remains its already accepted separate continuation.
    options.browser_node = None
    options.video = False
    inputs, receipt, contact = [], None, None

    def captured(path):
        path = _path(path, base)
        _require(path.is_file(), "The original source dependency has not arrived: " + str(path))
        before = identity(path)
        value = read_json(path)
        _require(identity(path) == before, "The original source changed while receiving: " + str(path))
        inputs.append({"path": str(path), **before})
        return value

    if "source_receipt" in item:
        source = item["source_receipt"]
        receipt = captured(source["path"])
        for check in source.get("checks", []):
            _require(digest(_at(receipt, check["path"])) == digest(check["equals"]),
                     "The source receipt differs at " + ".".join(check["path"]))
        selected = _at(receipt, source["sources_path"])
        selected = [selected] if isinstance(selected, dict) else selected
        _require(isinstance(selected, list) and selected and all(
            isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == {"source_collection_id", "source_id"}
            and all(isinstance(value, str) and value for value in row.values())
            for row in selected), "The receipt must return complete original source choices.")
        selection = {"sources": selected}
        if "title_path" in source:
            selection["title"] = _at(receipt, source["title_path"])
    elif "selection_file" in item:
        selection = captured(item["selection_file"])
    elif "selection" in item:
        selection = copy.deepcopy(item["selection"])
    else:
        selection = None
        options.manifest = [_path(path, base) for path in item["manifest"]]
        for path in options.manifest:
            captured(str(path))

    if selection is not None:
        _require(isinstance(selection, dict) and set(selection) <= {"sources", "title", "contact"}
                 and isinstance(selection.get("sources"), list) and selection["sources"],
                 "Keep the original ordered sources, optional title and contact.")
        selected_file = root / "selections" / (item["id"] + ".json")
        selected_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        atomic_json(selected_file, selection, immutable=True)
        options.selection = selected_file
    if "contact_json" in item:
        contact = captured(item["contact_json"])
        contact_file = root / "selections" / (item["id"] + "-contact.json")
        contact_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        atomic_json(contact_file, contact, immutable=True)
        options.contact_json = contact_file
    if "output" in item:
        options.output = _path(item["output"], base)
    else:
        suffix = item["output_from_receipt"]
        value = _at(receipt, suffix["path"])
        _require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,180}", value),
                 "The original report source ID must be an ordinary output-name component.")
        options.output = _path(suffix["directory"], base) / (suffix["prefix"] + value)
    _require(not options.output.is_relative_to(root) and not root.is_relative_to(options.output),
             "Keep each original report output separate from the course checkpoint directory.")
    binding = {"id": item["id"], "origin": item["origin"], "inputs": inputs,
               "output": str(options.output), "manifest": [str(path) for path in options.manifest or []],
               "selection": selection, "title": options.title,
               "contact": contact,
               "selected_study": options.selected_study}
    bound_file = root / "bindings" / (item["id"] + ".json")
    bound_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atomic_json(bound_file, binding, immutable=True)
    options.resume = options.output.exists()
    return options, binding


def run(args, receive, application, identity):
    _require(not args.create_workspace, "A receiving course continues its existing original Workspace.")
    _require(args.title is None and args.contact_json is None and not args.selected_study
             and args.browser_node is None and not args.video,
             "Keep report title/contact/selected-study choices on their original course items; "
             "use each retained receipt for its separate browser continuation.")
    _require(args.timeout > 0 and 1 <= args.upload_limit_gib <= 64,
             "Use the maintained receiver's positive timeout and upload capacity.")
    source = args.course.resolve(strict=True)
    original_identity = identity(source)
    course = read_json(source)
    _require(identity(source) == original_identity, "The course source changed during reading.")
    steps = _validate(course)
    workspace, root = args.workspace.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    project = Workspace(workspace).project
    _require(project["id"] == course["project_id"], "Continue the original project named by this course.")
    _require(not root.is_relative_to(workspace) and not workspace.is_relative_to(root)
             and not root.is_relative_to(application) and not application.is_relative_to(root),
             "Keep the course, original Workspace and application in separate trees.")
    if root.exists():
        _require(args.resume and root.is_dir(), "Use --resume for this retained receiving course.")
    else:
        _require(not args.resume, "The original receiving course directory is absent.")
        root.mkdir(parents=True)
    with held(root / ".scientific-report-course.lock", blocking=False):
        selected = {"schema": SCHEMA, "course": course, "workspace": str(workspace),
                    "source": {"path": str(source), **original_identity}}
        selection_file = root / "course-selection.json"
        if not selection_file.exists():
            _require(not any(path.name != ".scientific-report-course.lock" for path in root.iterdir()),
                     "The retained course lacks its original selection.")
        atomic_json(selection_file, selected, immutable=True)
        state_file = root / "scientific-report-course.json"
        state = read_json(state_file) if state_file.exists() else {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "operation_id": course["operation_id"],
            "project_id": project["id"], "workspace": str(workspace),
            "selection_sha256": digest(selected), "steps": {}}
        _require(state.get("selection_sha256") == digest(selected),
                 "Reopen the same original course selection.")
        state["state"] = "running"
        atomic_json(state_file, state)

        def save(key, status, **values):
            previous = state["steps"].get(key, {})
            state["steps"][key] = {**previous, "state": status, **values}
            atomic_json(state_file, state)
            print(json.dumps({"course": course["operation_id"], "step": key, "state": status,
                              **values}, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)

        outputs = {}
        for item in steps:
            key = item["id"]
            unmet = [name for name in item.get("depends_on", [])
                     if state["steps"].get(name, {}).get("state") != "complete"]
            if unmet:
                save(key, "waiting_dependency", dependencies=unmet)
                continue
            try:
                options, binding = _resolve_item(item, source.parent, root, args, identity)
                for other, output in outputs.items():
                    _require(not options.output.is_relative_to(output)
                             and not output.is_relative_to(options.output),
                             "Original course outputs overlap: " + other + " and " + key)
                outputs[key] = options.output
                save(key, "receiving", origin=item["origin"], output=str(options.output),
                     binding_sha256=digest(binding))
                code = receive(options)
                _require(code == 0, "The original report receiver returned " + str(code))
                receipt_file = options.output / "scientific-report-receiving.json"
                receipt = read_json(receipt_file)
                _require(receipt.get("state") == "complete"
                         and receipt.get("schema") == "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-workflow/v1"
                         and receipt.get("project_id") == project["id"]
                         and receipt.get("original_workspace") == str(workspace),
                         "The completed report belongs to another original receiving course.")
                save(key, "complete", receipt={"path": str(receipt_file), **identity(receipt_file)},
                     original_operation_id=receipt["operation_id"], edition_id=receipt["edition_id"],
                     tasks=receipt["tasks"], error=None)
            except BaseException as error:
                interrupted = not isinstance(error, Exception)
                if interrupted:
                    state["state"] = "interrupted"
                save(key, "interrupted" if interrupted else "needs_input_or_repair",
                     error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
                if interrupted:
                    raise
                # Each independent ready original proceeds in this same invocation.
                continue
        state["state"] = ("complete" if all(state["steps"].get(item["id"], {}).get("state") == "complete"
                                             for item in steps) else "incomplete")
        atomic_json(state_file, state)
        print(json.dumps({"course": course["operation_id"], "state": state["state"],
                          "receipt": str(state_file)}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
        return 0 if state["state"] == "complete" else 2

"""Operate saved scientific reports, downloads and independent Workspace receiving.

This command uses the application's original registered source import, report,
backup and restore queues. Continue a retained operation with --resume.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import signal
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import zipfile

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0] = [str(APP), str(APP / "operator")]
from model.common import atomic_json, digest, held, read_json, verify_file
from model.workspace import Workspace
from model import scientific_report_editions


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def identity(path):
    checksum, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    with Path(path).open("rb") as source:
        for part in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            size += len(part)
            checksum.update(part)
    return {"bytes": size, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()}


def archive_upload(operator, archive):
    """Reopen an exact retained upload through the original checked lookup."""
    archive = Path(archive)
    expected = {"filename": archive.name, "mime_type": "application/zip", **identity(archive)}
    upload_id = digest({"sha256": expected["sha256"], "filename": expected["filename"],
                        "media_type": expected["mime_type"]})
    metadata = operator.root / "uploads" / (upload_id + ".json")
    # Only absence of the metadata itself permits another streamed upload.
    # lstat sees a dangling metadata link as present; lookup/access/identity
    # failures must propagate instead of creating a replacement object.
    try:
        metadata.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        with archive.open("rb") as stream:
            record = operator.receive_upload(stream, expected["bytes"],
                                             expected["filename"], expected["mime_type"])
        mode = "streamed"
    else:
        record = operator.upload(upload_id)
        mode = "retained"
    require(isinstance(record, dict) and record.get("id") == upload_id
            and all(record.get(field) == value for field, value in expected.items()),
            "The original archive upload returned a different identity: " + archive.name)
    return record, {"mode": mode, "id": upload_id, **expected}


def load_operator():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "upstate_scientific_report_operator", APP / "operator/server.py")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    source.add_argument("--manifest", action="append", type=Path,
                        help="Original typed-report manifest; repeat in reading order.")
    source.add_argument("--selection", type=Path,
                        help="JSON with ordered sources, optional title and contact.")
    source.add_argument("--terrain-selection", type=Path,
                        help="Original Terrain response/title/reason JSON; prepares its report source without rerunning models.")
    source.add_argument("--course", type=Path,
                        help="Continue an explicit ordered manifest of original report operations.")
    parser.add_argument("--title")
    parser.add_argument("--contact-json", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--create-workspace", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--selected-study", action="store_true",
                        help="Also export and receive this report with its original editable study history.")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=1800)
    parser.add_argument("--upload-limit-gib", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--browser-node", type=Path,
                        help="Run the adjacent real browser continuation with this Node interpreter.")
    parser.add_argument("--video", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--assessment-preparation", type=Path,
                        help="Open the completed original assessment preparation in the same browser course.")
    parser.add_argument("--_native-worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(not args.assessment_preparation or (args.browser_node and not args.course),
            "The assessment chapter joins one original report browser continuation with --browser-node.")
    require(not args._native_worker or not args.course,
            "The native worker continues one original report operation.")
    if args.course:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            "upstate_scientific_report_course", Path(__file__).with_name("receive_course.py"))
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[spec.name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module.run(args, receive, APP, identity)
    return receive(args)


# Native libraries and executor threads cannot be stopped by Future.cancel().
# Keep the existing original operation in one owned process so its deadline also
# bounds shutdown, without changing the shared operator's normal drain behavior.
WORKER_STOP_GRACE = 5.0


def _worker_command(args):
    command = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--_native-worker",
               "--workspace", str(args.workspace.resolve()),
               "--output", str(args.output.resolve()),
               "--timeout", str(args.timeout),
               "--upload-limit-gib", str(args.upload_limit_gib)]
    if getattr(args, "terrain_selection", None):
        command += ["--terrain-selection", str(args.terrain_selection.resolve())]
    elif args.selection:
        command += ["--selection", str(args.selection.resolve())]
    else:
        for manifest in args.manifest or []:
            command += ["--manifest", str(manifest.resolve())]
    for name, option in (("title", "--title"), ("contact_json", "--contact-json"),
                         ("browser_node", "--browser-node"),
                         ("assessment_preparation", "--assessment-preparation")):
        value = getattr(args, name, None)
        if value is not None:
            command.append(option + "=" + str(value.resolve() if isinstance(value, Path) else value))
    for name, option in (("create_workspace", "--create-workspace"),
                         ("resume", "--resume"), ("selected_study", "--selected-study"),
                         ("video", "--video")):
        if getattr(args, name, False):
            command.append(option)
    return command


def _worker_progress(path, process_id):
    try:
        value = read_json(path)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("process_id") == process_id else None


def _stop_worker(process):
    """Stop only this receiver's process/session, including its own descendants."""
    def signal_worker(force):
        try:
            if os.name == "posix":
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL if force else signal.SIGTERM)
            elif force:
                process.kill()
            else:
                process.terminate()
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
    signal_worker(False)
    try:
        process.wait(timeout=WORKER_STOP_GRACE)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        signal_worker(True)
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=WORKER_STOP_GRACE)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            raise RuntimeError("The owned report process did not stop: " + str(process.pid)) from error
    # A native child may outlive the worker or ignore SIGTERM. Its process group
    # was created exclusively for this operation; finish stopping that group.
    if os.name == "posix":
        signal_worker(True)


def _record_worker_interruption(output, process_id, message):
    # The child has exited and released its original operation lock. Do not
    # overwrite a successor that another caller has already resumed.
    if not output.is_dir():
        return
    try:
        with held(output / ".scientific-report-receiving.lock", blocking=False):
            path = output / "receiving-progress.json"
            progress = _worker_progress(path, process_id)
            if progress is None:
                return
            if progress.get("phase") == "failed":
                return  # Preserve the child's exact native exception.
            previous = progress.get("phase")
            progress.update(phase="interrupted", interrupted_phase=previous,
                            error={"type": "TimeoutError", "message": message})
            atomic_json(path, progress)
    except BlockingIOError:
        return


def supervised_receive(args):
    """Run the same retained native receiver with a bounded per-phase lifetime."""
    process = None
    previous_termination = None
    def terminated(number, frame):
        raise SystemExit(128 + number)
    output = args.output.resolve()
    path = output / "receiving-progress.json"
    phase, began, failed_since = None, time.monotonic(), None
    failure = None
    try:
        if threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread():
            previous_termination = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, terminated)
        process = subprocess.Popen(_worker_command(args), start_new_session=os.name == "posix")
        began = time.monotonic()
        while process.poll() is None:
            current = _worker_progress(path, process.pid)
            now = time.monotonic()
            current_phase = ((current.get("phase"), current.get("task_id"))
                             if current is not None else None)
            if current_phase is not None and current_phase != phase:
                phase, began = current_phase, now
            if current is not None and current.get("phase") == "failed":
                if failed_since is None:
                    failed_since, failure = now, current.get("error")
                if now - failed_since >= WORKER_STOP_GRACE:
                    _stop_worker(process)
                    raise RuntimeError("The original report failed and its owned native shutdown "
                                       "did not finish: " + json.dumps(failure, allow_nan=False))
            elif now - began >= args.timeout:
                # Recheck the phase at the deadline before stopping a worker that
                # may just have completed the operation and advanced its receipt.
                latest = _worker_progress(path, process.pid)
                latest_phase = ((latest.get("phase"), latest.get("task_id"))
                                if latest is not None else None)
                if latest_phase != current_phase:
                    continue
                message = ("Resume the original retained report after its " +
                           (str(phase[0]) if phase else "startup") + " phase exceeded " +
                           str(args.timeout) + " seconds; owned process " + str(process.pid))
                _stop_worker(process)
                _record_worker_interruption(output, process.pid, message)
                raise TimeoutError(message)
            time.sleep(0.1)
        return process.returncode
    except BaseException:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            _stop_worker(process)
        raise
    finally:
        if previous_termination is not None:
            signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, previous_termination)


def receive(args):
    """Continue one original operation, including its retained output/task IDs."""
    require(args.timeout > 0 and 1 <= args.upload_limit_gib <= 64,
            "Use positive task time and upload capacity from 1 to 64 GiB.")
    workspace, out = args.workspace.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    require(not out.is_relative_to(workspace) and not workspace.is_relative_to(out)
            and not out.is_relative_to(APP) and not APP.is_relative_to(out),
            "Keep the original application, Workspace and receiving output in separate trees.")
    if not getattr(args, "_native_worker", False):
        return supervised_receive(args)
    if out.exists():
        require(args.resume and out.is_dir(), "Use --resume for the retained receiving output.")
    else:
        require(not args.resume, "The retained output is absent; start this receiving operation first.")
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
    with held(out / ".scientific-report-receiving.lock", blocking=False):
        return operate(args, workspace, out)


def operate(args, workspace, out):
    original = Workspace(workspace, create=args.create_workspace,
                         title="Upper Savannah observed science")
    manifests = [path.resolve(strict=True) for path in (args.manifest or [])]
    supplied = read_json(args.selection.resolve(strict=True)) if args.selection else {}
    require(isinstance(supplied, dict) and set(supplied) <= {"sources", "title", "contact"},
            "Selection JSON accepts the original ordered sources, title and contact.")
    require(not args.selection or isinstance(supplied.get("sources"), list) and supplied["sources"],
            "Provide a nonempty ordered source selection.")
    contact = read_json(args.contact_json.resolve(strict=True)) if args.contact_json else supplied.get("contact")
    title = args.title if args.title is not None else supplied.get("title")
    if title is not None:
        require(isinstance(title, str) and bool(title.strip()), "Enter a nonempty report title.")
    terrain_request = None
    if getattr(args, "terrain_selection", None):
        from source_tools import terrain_report_receiving
        require(args.selected_study, "The Terrain chapter retains its original editable selected Study; include --selected-study.")
        terrain_request = terrain_report_receiving.selection(args.terrain_selection)
    requested = {
        "schema": "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-selection/v1",
        "project_id": original.project["id"], "workspace": str(workspace),
        "manifests": [{"path": str(path), **identity(path)} for path in manifests],
        "sources": supplied.get("sources"), "title": title, "contact": contact,
        "selected_study": args.selected_study,
    }
    if terrain_request is not None:
        requested["terrain"] = terrain_request
    request_path = out / "receiving-selection.json"
    if request_path.exists():
        require(read_json(request_path) == requested,
                "Resume with the original sources, order, title, contact and Workspace.")
    else:
        require(not any(path.name != ".scientific-report-receiving.lock" for path in out.iterdir()),
                "The retained output lacks its original source selection.")
        atomic_json(request_path, requested, immutable=True)
    operation = digest(requested)
    progress_path = out / "receiving-progress.json"
    progress = read_json(progress_path) if progress_path.exists() else {
        "schema": "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-progress/v1",
        "operation_id": operation, "tasks": {}}
    require(progress.get("operation_id") == operation, "Reopen the matching receiving checkpoint.")

    def checkpoint(phase, **values):
        progress.update(phase=phase, **values)
        atomic_json(progress_path, progress)
        print(json.dumps({"phase": phase, **values}, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)

    module = load_operator()
    operator = module.Operator(workspace, out / "operator-state", create=False,
                               source_manifests=manifests,
                               upload_limit=args.upload_limit_gib * 1024**3)
    key = operator.primary
    tasks = {}

    def receive_archive(phase, archive):
        checkpoint(phase + "_upload", archive=str(archive), upload_state="checking")
        record, receipt = archive_upload(operator, archive)
        progress.setdefault("uploads", {})[phase] = receipt
        checkpoint(phase + "_upload", archive=str(archive),
                   upload_state="verified", uploads=progress["uploads"])
        return record

    def read(method, path, payload=None, owner=None):
        return operator.extensions.read(method, path, owner or key, payload or {})

    def action(phase, name, payload):
        queued = operator.submit(key, name, payload, "report_receive_" + operation[:24] + "_" + phase)
        progress["tasks"][phase] = {"id": queued["id"], "action": name}
        checkpoint(phase, task_id=queued["id"])
        if args.resume and queued["state"] in {"failed", "interrupted", "cancelled"}:
            operator.resume(queued["id"])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + args.timeout
        while True:
            task = operator.task_view(queued["id"])
            if task["state"] == "complete":
                tasks[phase] = task
                return task
            if task["state"] in {"failed", "interrupted", "cancelled"}:
                raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(task.get("error") or task, allow_nan=False))
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("Resume the original retained report task " + task["id"])
            time.sleep(0.2)

    def download(ticket, name):
        destination = out / name
        expected = {field: ticket[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}
        if destination.exists():
            require(identity(destination) == expected, "Retained download differs: " + name)
            return destination
        stream, record = operator.open_download(ticket["id"])
        temporary = destination.with_name("." + destination.name + ".receiving")
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        try:
            require({field: record[field] for field in expected} == expected,
                    "The original file ticket changed: " + name)
            checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
            with temporary.open("xb") as target:
                for part in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                    target.write(part)
                    count += len(part)
                    checksum.update(part)
                target.flush()
                os.fsync(target.fileno())
            require({"bytes": count, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()} == expected,
                    "The original download changed during transfer: " + name)
            os.link(temporary, destination)
        finally:
            stream.close()
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return destination

    try:
        checkpoint("opening", application=str(APP), workspace_key=key, process_id=os.getpid())
        routes = [
            ("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-catalog"),
            ("POST", "/api/source-reports/scientific-preview"),
            ("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition"),
        ]
        if args.selected_study:
            routes.append(("POST", "/api/study-transfer/preview"))
        require(all(operator.extensions.has_route(*route) for route in routes),
                "Install the complete saved scientific report family before receiving.")
        terrain_chapter = None
        if terrain_request is not None:
            require(operator.extensions.has_route("POST", "/api/terrain-conditioning/report-source-preview")
                    and operator.extensions.has_route("GET", "/api/terrain-conditioning"),
                    "Install the original Terrain scientific-source family.")
            terrain_chapter = terrain_report_receiving.prepare(
                original, out, terrain_request, read, action, download)
        choices = [terrain_chapter["source"]] if terrain_chapter else supplied.get("sources") or []
        if terrain_chapter and title is None:
            title = terrain_request["selection"]["title"]
        if manifests:
            choices = []
            registered = {row["path"]: row for row in operator.registered.values()}
            for index, path in enumerate(manifests):
                preview = operator.preview_source({"registered_id": registered[str(path)]["id"]})
                imported = action("source_%03d" % (index + 1), "source.import",
                                  {"preview_id": preview["id"]})["result"]
                matches = [entry for entry in imported["entries"]
                           if (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("report_schema") == "upstate.observed-report/v1"]
                require(len(matches) == 1, "Choose one typed report in manifest " + str(path))
                choices.append({"source_collection_id": imported["id"], "source_id": matches[0]["id"]})
        payload = {"sources": choices}
        if title is not None:
            payload["title"] = title
        if contact is not None:
            payload["contact"] = contact
        saved_preview = out / "report-preview.json"
        if saved_preview.exists():
            preview = read_json(saved_preview)
        else:
            preview = read("POST", "/api/source-reports/scientific-preview", payload)
            atomic_json(saved_preview, preview, immutable=True)
        require(preview.get("schema") == "upstate.observed-report-preview/v1"
                and preview.get("workspace_key") == key
                and preview.get("workspace") == str(workspace)
                and preview.get("id") == digest(preview.get("render_identity"))
                and preview.get("operation_id") == "observed-report-" + preview["id"][:20]
                and all(preview.get(name) == preview["render_identity"].get(name)
                        for name in ("title", "selection", "binding", "workspace"))
                and [{name: row[name] for name in ("source_collection_id", "source_id")}
                     for row in preview.get("sources", [])] == choices,
                "The retained preview changed the original scientific report selection.")
        scientific_report_editions.validate_request(original, payload, preview["render_identity"])
        # Submit the exact retained payload. A completed original task reopens
        # directly; a task interrupted after native rendering reconciles that
        # completed edition through the maintained render action.
        rendered = action("render", "source-reports.render", {**payload, "preview_id": preview["id"]})
        edition_id = rendered["result"]["scientific_report_edition_id"]
        require(edition_id == preview["id"], "Rendering changed the prepared scientific identity.")
        before = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition", {"id": edition_id})
        edition = before["edition"]
        require(edition["render_identity"] == preview["render_identity"],
                "The saved report changed the prepared selection.")
        replay = operator.submit(key, "source-reports.render", {**payload, "preview_id": preview["id"]},
                                 "report_receive_" + operation[:24] + "_render")
        require(replay["id"] == rendered["id"] and replay["state"] == "complete",
                "The completed report did not reopen the original queued operation.")
        copied = {}
        for ticket in before["_downloads"]:
            if ticket["label"] in {"report_pdf", "report_html", "report_markdown", "report_data"}:
                path = download(ticket, ticket["filename"])
                copied[ticket["label"]] = {"path": str(path), **identity(path)}
        require({"report_pdf", "report_html", "report_markdown", "report_data"} <= copied.keys(),
                "The original report omitted a complete PDF, HTML, Markdown or data export.")
        zipped = action("report_zip", "source-reports.export", {"id": edition_id})
        complete = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition", {"id": edition_id})
        report_archive = download(complete["archive"], "scientific-report.zip")
        files = {row["path"]: row for row in complete["files"]}
        with zipfile.ZipFile(report_archive) as archive:
            require(set(archive.namelist()) == set(files) and len(archive.namelist()) == len(files),
                    "The report ZIP changed the original complete file set.")
            for name, expected in files.items():
                checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                with archive.open(name) as stream:
                    for part in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):

                        checksum.update(part)
                require(count == expected["bytes"] and checksum.hexdigest() == expected["sha256"],
                        "The report ZIP changed original member " + name)

        tickets = backup.get("_downloads") or []
        require(len(tickets) == 1, "The original Workspace backup must expose its complete archive.")
        archive_path = download(tickets[0], "scientific-report-workspace.zip")
        upload = receive_archive("workspace", archive_path)
        restored_task = action("restore", "workspace.restore", {"upload_id": upload["id"]})
        restored_key = restored_task["result"]["workspace_key"]
        restored = operator.ws(restored_key)
        require(restored.project == original.project, "Receiving changed the original project identity.")
        after = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-edition", {"id": edition_id}, restored_key)
        require(after["edition"] == edition, "Reopening changed the original saved report edition.")
        require(after["edition"]["render_identity"]["workspace"] == str(workspace),
                "Receiving rewrote the original authoring Workspace in the scientific identity.")
        catalog = read("GET", "/api/source-reports/scientific-catalog", owner=restored_key)
        require(any(row["id"] == edition_id for row in catalog["editions"]),

        for descriptor in edition["files"].values():
            verify_file(restored.root / "scientific-report-editions" / edition_id, descriptor)

        for role, expected in copied.items():
            require(all(restored_roles[role][field] == expected[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")),

        if terrain_chapter:

            require(any(row["id"] == edition_id and row["source_choices"] == choices

                    "The selected study archive omitted the ordered original report.")
            selected_tickets = exported.get("_downloads") or []
            require(len(selected_tickets) == 1, "The selected study needs its original complete archive.")
            selected_archive = download(selected_tickets[0], "selected-scientific-report-study.zip")

            selected_task = action("selected_restore", "workspace.restore", {"upload_id": selected_upload["id"]})
            selected_key = selected_task["result"]["workspace_key"]

                "study_id": exported["result"]["id"], "workspace_key": selected_key,

                "original_nodes": retained["nodes"],
                "scientific_report_editions": retained["scientific_report_editions"],
            }
        if terrain_chapter:
            require(selected_receiving is not None, "Retain the Terrain selected Study receiving result.")
            terrain_selected = terrain_report_receiving.verify(
                selected_workspace, terrain_chapter, selected_receiving["original_nodes"])
        outcome = {
            "schema": "upstate.scientific-report-receiving-workflow/v1",
            "state": "complete", "operation_id": operation, "project_id": original.project["id"],
            "edition_id": edition_id, "title": edition["title"], "sources": choices,
            "render_identity": edition["render_identity"], "edition": edition,
            "original_workspace": str(workspace), "original_workspace_key": key,
            "restored_workspace": str(restored.root), "restored_workspace_key": restored_key,
            "operator_state": str(out / "operator-state"), "application": str(APP),
            "selected_study_receiving": selected_receiving,
            "report_files": copied, "report_archive": {"path": str(report_archive), **identity(report_archive)},
            "workspace_archive": {"path": str(archive_path), **identity(archive_path)},
            "uploads": progress.get("uploads", {}),
            "tasks": {phase: {"id": task["id"], "action": task["action"], "state": task["state"]}

            "browser_handoff": {"view": "sources", "workspace_key": restored_key,
                                "edition_id": edition_id, "sources": choices},
        }
        if terrain_chapter:
            outcome["terrain"] = {**terrain_chapter, "full_received": terrain_restored,
                                  "selected_received": terrain_selected}
        atomic_json(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json", outcome)
        checkpoint("closing", receipt=str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"),
                   edition_id=edition_id, restored_workspace_key=restored_key)
    except BaseException as error:
        checkpoint("failed", error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
        raise
    finally:
        operator.close()
    if args.browser_node:
        checkpoint("browser", receipt=str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"))
        try:
            browser(args, module, workspace, out)
        except BaseException as error:
            checkpoint("failed", error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
            raise
    checkpoint("complete", receipt=str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"),
               edition_id=edition_id, restored_workspace_key=restored_key)
    return 0


def browser(args, module, workspace, out):
    server, receipt = module.start_server(workspace, state_directory=out / "operator-state",
                                          upload_limit=args.upload_limit_gib * 1024**3)
    serving = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    private_url = out / ".operator-url"
    try:
        descriptor = os.open(private_url, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
        os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as target:
            target.write(receipt["operator_url"] + "\n")
        serving.start()
        command = [str(args.browser_node.resolve(strict=True)),
                   str(Path(__file__).with_name("receive_browser.mjs")),
                   "--url-file", str(private_url),
                   "--receiving-receipt", str(out / "scientific-report-receiving.json"),
                   "--output", str(out / "browser")]
        if getattr(args, "assessment_preparation", None):
            command += ["--assessment-preparation", str(args.assessment_preparation.resolve(strict=True))]
        if args.video:
            command.append("--video")
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=args.timeout)
    finally:
        if serving.is_alive():
            server.shutdown()
            serving.join()
        server.server_close()
        server.operator.close()
        private_url.unlink(missing_ok=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

- `selections/<item>.json`: the immutable original selection passed into the single-report receiver.
- `scientific-report-course.json`: every item's actual state, original operation/edition/task IDs, complete receipt identity and current exception.

The original per-report `scientific-report-receiving.json`, `receiving-selection.json`, progress, operator-state, files and archives stay in their original directories. A result for a different project or Workspace is rejected.

A new or extended explicit course uses a separate course checkpoint directory and may point at the same original report outputs. Those completed operations are still reused. Editing a frozen source selection does not silently repurpose its original operation.

Relative paths are resolved beside the course JSON. An item chooses exactly one of `manifest` (ordered path list), `selection` (original JSON), `selection_file`, or `source_receipt`. A receipt selector is an ordered list of original object keys; its `checks` compare exact retained values. `output_from_receipt` preserves the original producer-ID naming convention using an ordinary filename component. No command or Python import is accepted from the manifest.

## Source and browser ownership

This course joins the current ASTRA13, source-water and WATERLINK scientific-report continuations. Monitoring's existing campaign receiving, the transferred station/assessment/RL/hydrology courses, original native model operations and source assembly keep their current receivers. It adds no competing source preparation or native solve.

Each completed report receipt remains valid input to the maintained `receive_browser.mjs`. The existing authorized browser owner can open that original edition, all original downloads, reordered-source preview and its received selected study. Browser capabilities stay local. Keep the current host's actual browser access policy.

Sources: the accepted native instructions are retained in the example's `origin` values; producer contracts are `model/receptor_report_source.py`, `model/receiving_water_report_cli.py` and `model/receiving_water_report_source.py`; queue/receiving contracts are the maintained `receive_operator.py` and `operator/server.py`.

# Operate and receive saved scientific reports

The two commands in this directory continue the existing scientific report operation through the original operator. They use retained source manifests or exact saved source choices and produce a complete report edition, its readable files, an editable Workspace archive and independent receiving records.

## Native operation

Run from the complete application on the existing scientific receiver. The interpreter needs the application's retained dependencies, including ReportLab. This course formats original saved studies through the original queue.

Select the original Workspace, a separate receiving directory and one or more original typed-report manifests, in reading order:

~~~sh
python -B source/observed-report-20261013/receive_operator.py \
  --workspace /path/to/original-workspace \
  --output /path/to/report-receiving \
  --manifest /path/to/original-study/sources.json \
  --manifest /path/to/second-original-study/sources.json \
  --title "Upper Savannah scientific studies" \
  --selected-study
~~~

Each manifest must contain exactly one document marked **upstate.observed-report/v1**. Its original import brings the complete related source collection. Add **--create-workspace** for a new observed-science Workspace. Existing completed calibration, diagnostic, Monitoring and other study sources can be selected directly with **--selection /path/to/selection.json**:

~~~json
{
  "sources": [
    {
      "source_collection_id": "FULL_ORIGINAL_COLLECTION_ID",
      "source_id": "ORIGINAL_REPORT_SOURCE_ID"
    }
  ],
  "title": "Upper Savannah scientific studies",
  "contact": {
    "name": "Original report preparer",
    "organization": "Original project team",
    "email": ""
  }
}
~~~

Use the exact IDs from **Sources** or the original completed producer. The selection accepts sources, optional title and optional contact. The source order determines the report order. **--contact-json** can provide the same contact object separately.

The command performs the full maintained operation:

1. Import original manifests through source.import, or reopen the selected saved sources.
2. Preview the exact ordered scientific sources and queue source-reports.render.
3. Reopen the original completed operation and saved report edition.
4. Download PDF, HTML, Markdown and structured report data through their original file tickets.
5. Prepare and download the complete report ZIP, then read all original members.
6. Queue the complete Workspace backup, reuse its exact verified retained upload or stream the archive through the original receiving interface, restore it independently and reopen the same report in Sources.
7. With **--selected-study**, preview and export that saved report through Study transfer, receive its original selected archive, and reopen the same edition with its retained editable dependencies.

The selected-study option uses the current scientific-report Study transfer family. The complete Workspace operation remains available independently. The existing producer resolvers determine the original editable history carried with each selected report source.

### Resume the original operation

Repeat the same command with **--resume**. Keep the original Workspace, output directory, source manifests or selection, title, contact and selected-study choice. The command uses stable queue request IDs and reopens completed operations and downloads. Interrupted or failed original tasks resume through the operator's retained task record. Its progress and original selection live beside the result.

The original preview is saved before its render request is submitted. On resume, the receiver verifies that saved preview against the same ordered sources, title, contact and Workspace, then submits the identical original task payload. It does not request a new renderer-derived preview for this retained operation. A completed task reopens its original edition directly.

If execution stopped after the original renderer published its complete operation but before the edition or queue completion was saved, the same render action verifies those original output files and publishes the missing edition record. A later formatter version does not rerender that completed output. An operation that has not yet completed rendering still uses the original installed-source check; changing its renderer does not silently replace its selected edition.

The selected-study export likewise reuses its saved preview token and original request. Complete downloads use streaming byte and checksum verification. The original report identity retains its authoring Workspace path after receiving. Subsequent report editions use their own newly reviewed preview and retain this completed edition.

### Reuse the original verified archive upload

Before either the complete Workspace or selected-study restore, the receiver hashes the exact retained archive and derives the original upload ID from its SHA-256, filename and ZIP media type. If that upload's metadata exists in this operation's operator state, the existing authenticated upload lookup reopens it and checks the retained object's length and complete hash. The returned ID, filename, media type, byte length and SHA-256 must also match the downloaded archive. This avoids writing another temporary archive copy when resuming a completed upload.

A new streamed upload occurs only when that exact metadata file is absent. An inaccessible metadata record, missing or changed retained object, malformed record or different returned identity stops the same operation with its actual error. It does not trigger a replacement upload. The existing restore request and original task ID remain unchanged.

Both `receiving-progress.json` and the completed `scientific-report-receiving.json` expose `uploads.workspace` and, when selected, `uploads.selected_study`. Each records `mode` (`retained` or `streamed`), the original upload ID, filename, MIME type, byte count and SHA-256. The progress phases `workspace_upload` and `selected_study_upload` identify the actual archive check or transfer. Continue with the original command and `--resume`; keep its output and operator-state directory together.

**--timeout** sets the allowance for each original queued operation and receiving phase, default 1,800 seconds. The same command runs each report in one owned native process. Its supervisor follows that process's original progress record and gives startup, each queue operation, shutdown and the optional browser course their own deadline. An expired native thread cannot keep the course waiting indefinitely inside executor shutdown.

After expiry the supervisor stops that operation's process group, including its own native descendants, with a five-second termination grace before forced stop if needed. It preserves the child's exact failure record. If the supervisor detected the expiry first, it records the interrupted phase after the child releases the original operation lock; a newly resumed successor is never overwritten. **--resume** reopens the same output, task IDs, original preview and original source selection. Each independent ready course item can then continue in its own native process.

The native `scientific-report-receiving.json` is written after the report and both requested receiving paths complete. The progress file records `closing` while the operator drains, `browser` while the selected browser course runs, and `complete` after those phases finish. A native complete receipt remains available when a later browser phase needs to resume.

**--upload-limit-gib** sets the original receiver's archive capacity, default 4 GiB. Use the capacity appropriate to the retained project.

## Open the result

The output directory contains:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| report.pdf | Complete print report |
| report.html | Readable report with retained scientific figures |
| report.md | Editable report text |
| report-data.json | Original structured report sections and source choices |
| scientific-report.zip | Report files, original inputs, figures, selection and edition |
| scientific-report-workspace.zip | Complete editable Workspace and application |
| selected-scientific-report-study.zip | Selected report and editable study dependencies when requested |
| scientific-report-receiving.json | Actual report, source, queue, archive and restored Workspace identities |
| receiving-progress.json | Retained operation progress and any actual exception |

The receiving record gives the original and restored Workspace paths and the operator-state directory. Start the original server with the recorded original Workspace and operator state to reopen its registered restored projects. Keep the private operator URL in a local file for the browser continuation.

## Existing browser continuation

On the authorized browser receiver, open the same registered operator with Playwright/Chromium:

~~~sh
node source/observed-report-20261013/receive_browser.mjs \
  --url-file /path/to/private-operator-url \
  --receiving-receipt /path/to/report-receiving/scientific-report-receiving.json \
  --output /path/to/report-browser \
  --video
~~~

The browser selects the actual restored Workspace, opens the saved report and its live report frame, and downloads the original PDF, HTML, Markdown, data and complete ZIP. It then reuses the saved ordered studies, checks reorder previews, reloads the browser draft and reopens the report at desktop and phone widths. When the native record contains a selected-study restore, that independent Workspace is opened too.

The browser journal includes the original edition, completed downloads, screenshots, optional video and any actual interface error. Its default course reopens saved scientific work and prepares previews; it should produce no new queue submission.

If both native and browser execution are available on the same authorized host, pass **--browser-node /absolute/path/to/node** and optionally **--video** to the native command. It opens the original server over loopback, creates a private URL file with owner-only permissions, runs the adjacent browser continuation, and closes that server when finished. The private URL is omitted from the published journal.

For the completed original assessment preparation, also pass **--assessment-preparation /path/to/assessment-preparation** with **--browser-node**. This joins the existing [assessment browser chapter](ASSESSMENT_BROWSER.md) in the same page and browser context before the saved Sources report course. Use the retained output from `prepare_assessment.py`; the chapter opens the original studies and saved contexts and uses their existing queued report preparation and exact composer handoff. The option belongs to one original report continuation, so use its completed report receipt rather than adding it to a multi-report **--course** invocation.

The existing ASTRA13 operation0669 owns the native source/render/receiving course. Its original browser owner can run the browser continuation against the completed native record. Source preparation, model studies and their original report producers continue in their existing project operations.

## Continue several accepted report operations

Use **--course regional-report-course.example.json** to run an explicit ordered group of original report selections through this same receiver. Each item retains its original output, queue tasks, report edition and complete receiving record. Missing source inputs or a failed item are recorded while independent ready items continue. Resume the same course with **--resume**. The complete three-operation native example, original source preparations and identity behavior are in [RECEIVING_COURSE.md](RECEIVING_COURSE.md).
